s: OkAraH । sa tu caturddaSasvaravarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaM ozWaH kaRWaSca । (odOtoH kaRWOzWam” । ityukteH । taTA ca SikzAyAm । “eE tu kaRWa-tAlavyAvoO kaRWOzWajO smftO” .) sa dIrGaH plutaSca Bavati na hrasvaH ॥ (pratyekamudAttAnudAttasvaritaBedAt triviDo'pi punaranunAsikAnanunAsikaBedAt zaqviDa etena dvAdaSaviDa eva .) “raktavidyullatAkAraM OkAraM kuRqalI svayam । atra brahmAdayaH sarvve tizWanti satataM priye ॥ paYcaprARamayaM varRaM sadASivamayaM sadA । sadA ISvarasaMyuktaM caturvvargapradAyakam” ॥ iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ (vaNgaBAzAyAM) tasya leKanaprakAro yaTA, -- “okAramaDyadakzetu gatA tUrdDvagatAyatA । kiYcit sA vAmato vakrA tAsu brahmeSavizRavaH ॥ SaktimaDyagatA reKA DyAnamasya pracakzyate” । iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ asya nAmAni yaTA, “OkAraH Saktiko nAdastejaso vAmajaNGakaH । manurardDagraheSaSca SaNkukaRaH sadASivaH ॥ aDodantaYca kaRWOzWO saNkarzaRaH sarasvatI । AjYA cordDvamuKI SAnto vyApinI prakftaH payaH ॥ anantA jvAlinI vyomA caturddaSI ratipriyaH । netramAtmakarziRo ca jvAlAmAlinikA BfguH” ॥ iti tantraSAstram ॥ SezadaSanaH । satyAntaH । iti vIjavarRABiDAnam ॥ (mAtfkAnyAse'DodantapaNktO nyasyatayA tacCabdenApyaBiDAnam । mAtfkAnyAsamantro yaTA, -- oM nama UrdDvadantapaNktO OM namo'DodantapaNktO” ॥ anubanDaviSezaH । yaduktaM kavikalpadrume । “ornizWAtana Oraniw” । tena dfSi rO prekzaRe ityasya xwi kfte drakzyati iti syAt ॥)
vya, AhvAnam । samboDanam । iti medinI ॥ viroDaH । nirRayaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (gaRaBedaH । sa ca cAdiH । iti pARiniH । 1 । 4 । 57 ॥)
vya, SUdrARAM praRavaH । yaTA, -- “caturddaSasvaro yo'sO seturOkArasaMjYitaH । sa cAnusvAranAdAByAM SudrARAM seturucyate” ॥ iti tantrasAraDftakAlikApurARam ॥
puM, anantaH । ityekAkzarakozaH ॥ nisvanaH । iti medinI ॥
v: OkAraH svaravarRRaBedaH kaRWOzWasTAnayoruccAryyaH dIrGaH dvimAtratvAt । plutastu trimAtraH । sa ca udAttAnudAtta svaritaBedAt triviDo'pi anunAsikAnanunAsikAByAM puna rdvEviDyAt zaqviDaH evaM pluto'pi zaqviDaH । tena dvAdaSaviDaH । taparatve kAraparatve ca svarUpamAtraparaH । tantretasya vAcakaSabdA varRRABiDAne uktA yaTA । “okAraH SaktikonAdastEjasovAmajaNGakaH । manurUrdDagraheSaSca SaNkukarRRaH sadASivaH । aDodantaSca kaRWOzWO saNkarzaRaH sarasvatI । AjYA cordDamuKI SAntA vyApinI prakftiHparA । anantA jvAlinI vyomA caturddaSI ratipriyaH । netramAtrAkarziRI ca jvAlAmAlinikA BfguH” । tadaDizWAtfdevatA ca tatrEvoktA । “OkAre qAkinI siMhanAdinI caRqaBeravI” tasya DyeyarUpaM kAmaDe॰ ta॰ uktaM yaTA “raktavidyullatAkAramokAraM kuRqalIM svayam । atra brahmAdayaH sarvve tizWanti satataM priye! । paYcaprARamayaM varRRaM sadASivamayaM sadA । sadA ISvarasaMyuktaM caturvvargapradAyakam” । mAtfkAnyAse'DodantapaNktOnyasyatvAttacCabdavAcyatA'syeti boDyam ।

v: pu॰ uSInarasyApatyam utsA॰ aY । uSInarasyApatyezu SivipraBftizu । uSInaranfpaSca 1375 pf॰ uSInaraSabde uktaH । tatsutASca “uSInarasya patnyastu paYca rAjarzivaMSajAH । nf gA kfmirnavA darvA paYcamI tu dfSadvatI । uSInarasya putrAstu paYca tAsu kulodvahAH । tapasA cEva mahatA jAtA vfdDasya cAtmajAH । nfgAyAstu nfgaHputraH kfmyAH kfmirajAyata । navAyAstu navaH putrodarvAyAH suvrato 'Bavat । dfSadvatyAstu saMjajYe SivirOSInaro nfpaH” harivaM॰31 a॰ uktAH taccaritaYca BA॰ vana॰ 196 a॰ । “devAnAM kaTA saMjAtA mahItalaM gatvA mahIpatiM SivimOSInaraM sADvenaM jijYAsizyAma iti । evaM Bo ityuktvA agnIndrAvupAtizWetAm । agniH kapotarUpeRa tamaByaDAvadAmizArTamindraH SyenarUpeRa । aTa kapoto rAjYo divyAsanAsInasya utsaNgaM nyapatat । aTa purohito rAjAnamavravIt । prARarakzArTaM SyenAdBIto BavantaM prARArTI prapadyate । vasu dadAtu antavAn pArTivo'sya nizkftiM kuryyAt । GoraM kapotasya nipAtamAhuH । aTa kapoto rAjAnamabravot । prARarakzArTaM SyenAdBIto BavantaM prARArTI prapadye । aNgEraNgAni prApyArTI munirBUtvA prARAMstvAM prapadye । svADyAyena karzitaM vrahmacAriRaM mAM vidDi । tapasA damena yuktamAcAryyasyApratikUlaBAziRam evaM yuktamapApaM mAM vidDi । gadAmi vedAn vicinomi CandaH sarve vedA akzaraSo me aDItAH । na sADu dAnaM Srotriyasya pradAnaM mA pradAH SyenAya na kapoto'smi । aTa Syeno rAjAnaBavravIt । paryyAyeRa vasatirmmA Bavezu sarge jAtaH pUrvvamasmAt kapotAt । tvamAdadAno'Ta kapotamenaM mA tvaM rAjan! viGnakarttA BaveTAH । rAjovAca । kenedfSI jAtu purA hi dfzwA vAgucyamAnA Sakunena saMskftA । yo vE kapotovadatemAYca Syena uBO viditvA kaTamastu sADu । nAsya varzati varzakAle nAsya vIjaM rohati kAla uptam । BItaM prapannaM yohi dadAti Satrave na trARaM laBate trARamicCan sa kAle । jAtA hrasvA prajA pramIyate sadA na vE bAsaM pitaro'sya kurvate । BItaM prapanna yohi dadAti Satrave nAsya devAH pratigfhRanti havyam । moGamannaM vindati cApracetAH svargAllokAdBraSyati SIGrameva । BItaM prapannaM yo hi dadAti Satrave sendrA devAH praharantyasya vajram । ukzARaM paktvA saha odanena asmAt kapotAt prati te nayantu । yasmin deSe ramase'tIva Syena! tatra mAMsaM Sivayaste vahantu । Syena uvAca । nokzARaM rAjan prArTayeyaM na cAnyadanyanmAMsamaDikaM vA kapotAt । devErdattaH so'dya mamEza Bakzyastanme dadasva SakunAnAmaBAvAt । rAjovAca । ukzARaM veha tamanUnaM nayantu te paSyantu puruzA mamEva । BayAhitasya dAyaM mamAntikAttvAM prApayantu tvaM hyenaM mA hiMsIH । tyaje prARAnnEva dadyAM kapotaM sOmyo hyayaM kinnu jAnAmi Syena! । yaTA kleSaM mA kuruzveha sOmya! nAhaM kapotamarpayizye kaTaYcit । yaTA mAM hi vE sADuvAdEH prasannAH praSaMseyuH SivayaH karmmaRA ta । yaTA Syena! priyameva kuryyAM praSADi mAM yadvadestat karomi । Syena uvAza । UrordakziRAdutkftya svapiSita tAvadrAjan! yAvanmAMsaM kapotena samam । taTA tasmAt sADu trAtaH kapotaH praSaMseyuH SivayaH kftaYca priyaM syAnmameti । aTa sa dakziRAdUrorutkftya svamAMsapeSIM tulayA DArayan gurutara eva kapota AsIt । punaranyaduccakartta gurutara eva kapotaH । evaM sarvvaM samaDikftya SarIraM tulAyAmAropayAmAsa tattaTApi gurutara eva kapota AsIt । aTa rAjA svayameva tulAmAruroha । na ca vyalIkamAsIdrAjYa etadvfttAntaM dfzwvA trAta ityuktvA prAlIyata SyenaH । aTa rAjA avravIt kapotaM vidyuH SivayastvAM kapota! pfcCAmi te Sakune! ko nu SyenaH । nAnISvara IdfSaM jAtu kuryyAdetaM praSnaM Bagavanme vicakzva । kapota uvAca । vESvAnaro'haM jvalano DUmaketuraTEva Syeno vajra hastaH SacIpatiH । sADu jYAtuM tvAmfzaBaM sOraTeyaM nO jijYAsayA tvatsakASaM prapannO । yAmetAM peSIM mama nizkrayAya prAdAdBavAnasinotkftya rAjan । etadvo lakzma SivaM karomi hiraRyavarRaM ruciraM puRyaganDam । etAsAM prajAnAM pAlayitA yaSasvI surarzIRAmaTa sammato BfSam । etasmAt pArSvAt puruzo janizyati kapotaMrometi ca tasya nAma । kapotaromARaM SivinOdBidaM puttraM prApsyati nfpavfzaM saMhananaM yaSodIpyamAnaM drazwAsi SUramfzaBaM sOraTAnAm” uSInaraSabde darSitataccaritamevaMrUpaM tacca Sivereveti bahuBiHkalpya te tatra pitAputrayoraBedopacArAt uSInaraSabdaprayogAt iti । vastutaH kalpaBedAt uSInarasya tatputraSiveSca taTA caritamityaviroDaH । ayaYca yayAterdOhitraH tena ca yayAteH puRayakzaye svargAt patane tasmE svapuRya dattvA'sO punaH svargalokaM prApitaH tatkaTA yaTA । “pfcCAmi tvAM SivirOSInaro'haM mamApi lokAyadi santIha tAta! । yadyantarokze yadi vA divi SritAH kzetrajYaM tvAM tasya Darmmasya manye । yaTAtiruvAca । yattvaM vAcA hfdayenApi sADUn parIpsamAnAnnAvamaMsTA narendra! । tenAnantAdivi lokAH SritAste vidyudrUpAH svanavantomahAntaH । SiviruvAca । tAMstvaMlokAn pratipadyasva rAjan mayAdattAnyadi nezwaH krayaste । nacAhaM tAn pratipatsyeha dattvA yatra gatvA nAnuSocanti DIrAH” “ante ca yajAtirasmi nahuzasya putraH pUroH pitA sArvAnOmastvihAsam । guhyaM cArTaM mAmakeByo bravImi mAtAma ho'haM BavatAM prakASam” BA॰ A॰ 93 a॰ । uSInarasya gotrApatyam iY । OSInaritadgotrApatye puMstrI striyAM NIp । “SUdrAyAM gOtamo yatra mahAtmA saMSitavrataH । OSInaryyAmajanayat kAkzIvAdyAn sutAn muniH” BA॰ sa॰ 20 a॰ । tasyApatyam ata iYapi । OSInari Sivinfpe । “ArzRizeRo dilIpaSca mahAtmA cApyuSInaraH । OSInariH puRqarIkaH SaryAtiH SaraBaH SuciH” BA॰ sa॰ 8 । yamasaBAvarRane ।

a: औच्चैःश्रवसः — N. of Indra's horse.

m: औच्च्य n. (fr. उच्च), height, distance (of a planet), Sūryas.

s: strI, (ucitasya BAvaH । brAhmaRAditvAt vyaY + NIz । “halastadDitasya” । 6 । 4 । 150 । iti yalopaH ॥) Ocityam । iti liNgAdisaMgrahe amaraH ॥ (“sAmarTyamOcitI deSaH kAlo vyaktiH svarAdayaH” । iti sAhityadarpaRam ॥)
m: औचिती f. (fr. उचित), fitness, suitableness, decorum, Sāh.; Naiṣ.; Rājat. &c.
औचित्यालंकार m. N. of wk.

s: klI, (ucita + zyaY .) ucitasya BAvaH । upayuktatA । yogyatvam । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA sAhityadarpaRe 3 ya paricCede । “etA api yaTOcityAduttamADamamaDyamAH” ॥)
v: na॰ ucitasya BAvaHzyaY । yuktatve । “etA api yaTOcityAduttamADamamaDyaBAH” sA॰ da॰ । zittvasAmarTyAt strItvamapi tatra NIz yalopaSca । OcitI tatrArTe । sAmarTyamOcitI deSaH kAlovyaktiH svarAdayaH” sA॰ da॰ dfQA॰ imanic ucitimApyatra pu॰ ।
m: औचित्य n. fitness, suitableness, decorum, Sāh.; Kathās.; Kṣem. &c.
the state of being used to, habituation, Kathās. xxiv, 95; Suśr. &c.
a: औचित्यं, औचिती — [उचित-ष्यञ् यलोपे ङीष्] 1 Aptness, fitness, propriety, suitableness. --2 Congruity or fitness, as one of the several circumstances which determine the exact meaning of a word in a sentence (such as संयोग, वियोग &c.); सामर्थ्यमौचिती देशः कालो व्यक्तिः स्वरादयः S. D. 2; in the example पातु वो दयितामुखं there is औचिती or fitness in taking मुख to mean सांमुख्यं (meeting) instead of आननं. --3 Habituation.

m: औदारिक m. (fr. उदार), (with Jainas) the gross body which invests the soul, Sarvad.; HYog.
a: औदारिकं — (With Jainas) The gross body which envelopes the soul.

m: औदारिक—शरीर n. the coarse body (perishing at death), Śīl.
औदार्य n. generosity, nobility, magnanimity, MBh.; R.; Daś. &c.
liberality, Kathās.
noble style, Sāh.
a: औदार्यं — [उदार-ष्यञ्] 1 Generosity, nobility, magnanimity. --2 Greatness, excellence. --3 Depth of meaning (अर्थसंपत्ति); स सौष्ठवौदार्यविशेषशालिनीं विनिश्चितार्थामिति वावभाददे Ki. 1. 3; see Malli. on Ki. 11. 40; and उदारता also under उदार.

m: औदार्य-चिन्तामणि m. N. of a Prākṛt grammar.
औदार्य—ता f. liberality, Pañcad.

s: klI, (udArasya BAvaH । udAra + zyaY .) udAratA । iti hemacandraH ॥ (vAgguRaBedaH । yaTA kirAte 1 । 3 ॥ “sa sOzWavOdAryyaviSezaSAlinom” iti “OdAryyaM arTasampattiH” iti mallinATaH ॥ sAttviko nAyakaguRaBedaH । yaTA sAhityadarpaRe 3 । 58 । “SoBA vilAso mADuryyaM gAmBIryyaM DEryyatejasI । lalitOdAryyamityazwO sattvajAH pOruzA guRAH” ॥ tallakzaRaM yaTA tatrEva 3 । 63 । “dAnaM sapriyaBAzaRamOdAryyaM SatrumitrayoH samatA” ॥ nAyikAlaNkAraBedaH । yaTA, tatrEva 3 । 94 । “yOvane sattvajAstAsAmazwAviMSatisaMKyakAH । alaNkArAstatra BAvahAvahelAstrayo'NgajAH” ॥ SoBA kAntiSca dIptiSca mADuryyaYca pragalBatA । OdAryyaM DEryyamityete saptEva syurayatnajAH” ॥ tallakzaRaM yaTA tatrEva 3 । 103 । “OdAryyaM vinayaH sadA” ॥ asya udAharaRaM yaTA tatrEva । “na brUte paruzAM giraM vitanute na BrUyugaM BaNguraM nottaMsaMkzipati kzitO SravaRataH sA mesPuwe'pyAgasi kAntA garBagfhe gavAkzavivaravyApAritAkzyA vahiH saKyA vaktramaBiprayacCati paraM paryyaSruRI locane” ॥ manaso vfttiBedaH । yaTA paYcadaSI । 15 । 3 । “SAntA DorAstaTA mUQA manaso vfttayastriDA । vErAgyaM kzAntirOdAryyamityAdyA GoravfttayaH” ॥)
v: na॰ udArasya BAvaH guRavacanatvAt zyaY । udAratAyAm । “OdAryyaYca nAyakayorayatnasidDasAtvikAlaNkAraviSezaH । yaTAha sA॰ da॰ “SoBA kAntiSca dIptiSca mADuryyaYca pragalBatA । OdAryyaM DEryyamitTete saptEva syurayatnajAH” iti viBajya । “OdAryyaM vinayaH sadeti” lakzitam । sAtvikapuruzaguRaBedaSca yaTAha tatrEva । “SoBA vilAso mADuryyaM gAmBIryyaMDEryyatejasI । lalitOdAryyamityazwO satvajAH pOruzAguRAH” iti viBajya । “dAnaM sapriyaBAzaRamOdAryyaM SatrumitrayoH samateti” lakzitam । 2 vAkyasyArTasampattO ca । “sasOzWavOdAryya viSezaSAlinIM viniScitArTAmiti vAcamAdade” kirA॰ । “OdAryyamarTasampattiH” malli॰ । tacca vAgguRaBedaH “saMskAravattvamodIryyamityAdinA” hemaca॰ vAgguRadarSane ukteH ।

na॰ udAsInasya BAvaH zyaY । SuBASuBayorupekzAyAm tAwasTye । “paryyApto'si prajAH pAtumOdAsInyena varttitum” raGuH । 2 rAhitye 3 rAganivfttO ca “na ca svaBAvaprAptahantyaTAnurAgeRa naYaH SakyamaprAptakriyArTatvaM kalpayitum, hananakriyAnivfttyOdAsInyavyatirekeRa” “aBAvabudDiScOdAsInTakAraRam” “tasmAt prasaktakriyAnivfttyOdAsInyameva “brAhmaRona hantavya” ityAdizu pratizeDArTaM manyAmahe” iti ca SArIrakaBAzyam ।
m: औदासीन्य n. (fr. उद्-आसीन), indifference, apathy, disregard, R.; Daś.; Ragh. &c.
a: औदासीन्यं, औदास्यं — [उदासीन or उदास ष्यञ्] 1 Indifference, apathy; पर्याप्तेसि पजाः पातुमौदासीन्येन वर्तितुं R. 10. 25; इदाभीमौदास्यं यदि भजसि भागीरथि G. L. 4. --2 Solitariness, loneliness. --3 Perfect indifference (to worldly affairs), stoicism.

s: klI, (udAsa + zyaY .) udAsasya BAvaH । vErAgyam । anurAgAdiSUnyatA । yaTA । “OdAsyasaMvidavalambitaSUnyamudrAmasmin dfSoH patitatAmavalokya BEmyAH” । ityAdi nEzaDam ॥ “kzORIviliKanahetorvayamapi kubjAH kimOdAsyam” । iti padyAvalI ॥
v: na॰ udAste ud + Asa--ac tasya BAvaH zyaY । vErAgye rAgaSUnyatAyAm 2 manoyogavirahe । “OdAsya saMvidabalambitaSUnyamudrAmasmindfSornipatitAmavagamya BEmyAH” nEza॰ “kzORIviliKanahetorvayamapi kubjAH kimOdAsyam” padyAvalI ।
m: औदास्य n. (fr. 2. उद्-आस) id., Naiṣ.; Śāntiś. &c.
औदात्त्य n. (fr. उदात्त), the state of having the high tone or accent.

v: pu॰ udBArasyarzerapatyam iY । udBArarzeH putre KaRqike fzO । “KaRqika evOdBArirasya prAyaScittaM veda” Sata॰ brA॰ 1, 8, 34, 1 ।
m: औद्भारि m. a descendant of Ud-bhāra, N. of Khaṇḍika, ŚBr. xi.
औद्भट m. pl. the pupils of Ud-bhaṭa, Daśar.
औद्भेत्त्र n. (fr. उद्-भेत्तृ) id., MaitrS. ii, 11, 4.
औद्भेत्त्रिय n. id., ĀpŚr.

s: klI, (udBida + svArTe'R .) sAmBarilavaRam । asya guRAH । (yaTA suSrute । sUtrasTAne 46 aH ॥ “laGu tIkzRozRamutkledi sUzRaM vAtAnulomanam । sutiktaM kawusaMskAraM vidyAllavaRamOdBidam” ॥) tIkzRatvam । utkledakAritvam । kzArayuktatvam । kawutvam । tiktatvam । kozWabadDatAnAhaSUlanASitvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ (asya paryyAyo guRASca yaTA -- “OdBidaM pAMSulavaRaM yajjAtaM BUmitaH svayaMH kzAraM guru kawu snigDaM SItalaM vAtanASanam” ॥ iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe । 1 BAge ॥ “satiktakawukakzAraM tIkzRamutkledi cOdBidam” । iti vABawe sUtrasTAne । 6 a ॥) udBido jAtaM jalam । tasya guRAH । maDuratvam । pittaSamanatvam । avidAhitvam । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ (“OdBidaM pittaSamanaM maDuraM na vidAhi ca” ॥ iti vEdyakacakapARikftahavyaguRe pARIyavarge ॥ asya vyAKyAyAM SivadAsenoktaM yaTA । “OdBidaM nimnapradeSAdUrdDvamuttizWajjalam” ॥ udBido jAtaM dravyAdi । yaTA ॥ “tat nastriviDaM jYeyaM jANgalOdBidapArTivam” । “BOmamOzaDamuddizwamOdBidantu caturvviDam । vanaspatirvIruDaSca vAnaspatyastaTOzaDiH” ॥ “mUlatmaksAraniryAsanAqasvarasapallavAH । kzArAH kzIraM PalaM puzpaM BasmatElAni kaRwakAH ॥ patrARi SudDAH kandASca prarohaScOdBido gaRaH” । iti carake sUtrasTAne । 1 aH ॥)
v: na॰ udBinatti ud + Bida--ka--svArTe'R । 1 pAMSulavaRe । “OdBidaM pAMSulavaRaM yajjAtaM BUmitaH svayam । kzAraM guru kawusnigDaM SlezmalaM vAtanASanamiti” tasya guRAH “vidAryyamUmiM nimnAM yanmahatyA DArayA sravet । tattoyamOdBidaM nAma vadantIti maharzayaH” ityukte 2 jalaBede ca “OdBidaM vAri pittaGnamavidAhyatiSItalam । prIRanaM maDuraM balyamIzadvAtakaraM laGu” । vEdyakAntaram suSrute AntarikzajalamuktvA “tasyAlABe BOmaM taccAkASaguRabahulaM tatpunaH saptaviDam । tadyaTA kOpaM nAdeyaM sArasaM tAqAkaM prAsravaRamOdBidaMcORWyamiti । tatra varzAsvAntarikzamOdBidaM vA seveta mahAguRatvAt” ityAdi uktvA “kaPaGna dIpanaM hfdyaM laGu prasravaRodBavam । maDuraM pittaSamanamavidAhyOdBidam smftam” । tadguRAH uktAH । OdBidalavaRaguRAstu tatrEva । “laGu tIkzRozRamutkledi sUkzmaM vAtAnulomanam । sutiktaM kawusaMskAraM vidyAllavaRamOdBidam”
m: औद्भिद mfn. (fr. 2. उद्-भिद्), coming forth, springing forth, breaking through, issuing from, MBh.; Suśr.
forcing one's way towards an aim, victorious, VS. xxxiv, 50
औद्भिद n. (with and without लवण) fossil salt, Suśr.
(scil. उदक) water breaking through (the earth and collecting in a mine, L.), Suśr. i, 170, 12.
a: औद्भिद — a. (दी f.) [उद्भिद्-अण्] 1 Issuing (as from a well). --2 Victorious. --दं 1 Spring water. --2 Fossil salt, rock salt.

v: na॰ udBidomAvaH zyaY । vfkzAdInAmutpattO । “jEtraM ca ma OdBidyaM ca me yajYena kalpantAm” yaju॰ 18, 9, udBidoBAvaH OdBidyaM cUtAditarorutpattiH vedadI॰ ।
m: औद्भिद्य n. forcing one's way to an aim, success, victory, VS. xviii, 9; TBr. ii.
a: औद्भिद्यं — 1 Victoriousness. --2 Proluction of plants.

s: klI, (udBid + jana + qa + svArTe aR .) pAMSavalavaRaM । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: na॰ udBidya jAyate jana--qa svArTe'R । pAMSulavaRe rAjani॰ ।
m: औद्भिज्ज mfn. (fr. उद्भिज्-ज), coming forth from the earth, Hariv. 11122
औद्भिज्ज n. fossil salt, L.
a: औद्भिज्जं — [उद्भिज्ज-अण्] Fossil salt.

v: tri॰ udDArAya udDftyadAnAya praBavati WaY । viBAgakAle udDArArTaM deye dravyaBede । “viprasyOdDArikaM deyamekAMSaSca praDAnataH” manuH ।
m: औद्धारिक mfn. (fr. उद्-धार), belonging to or forming the part to be set aside, Mn. ix, 150.
a: औद्धारिक — a. (की f.) [उद्धार-ठञ्] Deducted from patrimony, portionable, heritable. --कं A portion or inheritance (deducted from patrimony).

s: klI, (udData + zyaY .) udDatasya BAvaH । yaTA । “asUyAnyaguRardDInAmOdDatyAdarAhizRutA । BrUBaNgadozasaMGozaraktAkzivEkftAdikft” ॥ iti sAhityadarpaRe 3 paricCedaH ॥
v: na॰ udDatasya BAvaH । avinItaBAve tacca “asUyAnya guRardDInAmOdDatyAdyasahizRatA” sA॰ da॰ uktalakzaRam ।
m: औद्धत्य n. (fr. उद्-धत), arrogance, insolence, overbearing manner, disdain, Kathās.; Sāh.
(with Buddhists) self-exaltation (one of the 10 fetters which bind a man to existence), MWB. 127
a: औद्धत्यं — [उद्धत-ष्यञ्] 1 Arrogance, insolence. --2 Boldness, bold or adventurous deeds; औद्धत्यमायोजितकामसूत्रं Māl. 1. 4.

m: औद्धव m. pl. (fr. उद्-धव), grass left over of the sacrificial straw, ĀpŚr. viii, 14, 4
औद्धव mf(ई)n. consisting of such grass, ĀpŚr. viii, 14, 5
coming from or spoken by Uddhava, relating to Uddhava, Śiś. ii, 118.
औद्धव—मय mfn. id. Comm. on ib.
औदीच्य mfn. (fr. उदीची f. of 2. उदञ्च्), coming from or relating to the northern country, northern Comm. on MBh. Comm. on Pat.
औदीच्य—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.

v: puMstrI udaBfjjasyApatyam iY । 1 udBfjjasyApatye tatoyuvapratyayasya pElAdi॰ luk । 2 tadIyayuvApatye ca । evaM Odamajji OdameDi Odavraji OdaSudDi ityete'pi SabdAH tattadapatye tattadyuvApatye ca ।
m: औदभृज्जि m. a descendant of Uda-bhṛjja, ib.

a: औदंचन — a. (नी f.) [उदंचन-अण्] Contained in a bucket or pitcher.

m: औदङ्कीय m. a king of the Audaṅkis, ib.
औदङ्कि m. a descendant of Udaṅka g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96
m. pl. N. of a warrior tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 3, 110.
औदशुद्धि m. a descendant of Uda-śuddha g. पैलादि, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 39.

s: klI, (udaSvit + “udaSvito'nyattarasyAm” । 4 । 2 । 19 । iti pakze aR .) ardDajalayuktaGolaM । iti hemacandraH ॥ (udaSvicCabde 'sya viSezo jYAtavyaH ॥)
v: tri॰ udaSviti takraBede saMskftaH aR । udaSvidrUpatakre saMskftaBakzvadravye । pakze Wak udaSvitko'pyatra udaSvidiva aNgulyA॰ Wak । OdaSvitka tatsadfSe tri॰ ।
m: औदश्वित and औदश्वित्क mfn. (fr. उद-श्वित्), dressed with or made of buttermilk, like buttermilk, Pāṇ.
a: औदश्वित, --श्वित्क्र — a. (ती, की f.) [उदश्वित् अण् ठक्वा] Made of, or seasoned with, butter-milk. --तं Butter-milk with an equal proportion of water.

s: klI, (udaSviti saMskftam । “udaSvito'nyatarasyAm 4 । 2 । 19 iti Wak । “isusuktAntAt kaH” । 7 । 3 । 51 । iti Wasya kaH .) ardDajalamiSritaGolam । iti hemacandraH ॥

v: tri॰ udacyate utkzipya Driyate'smin udaYcanojalADAraH maRikastasyedam aR । maRikasTite jalAdO (jAlArajala) “enAM (SaParIm) tata AdAya nyaDAdOdaYcanodake” BAga॰ 8, 34, 15 । “OdaYcanodake maRikasTajale” SrIDaraH udaYcanasya sannikfzwadeSAdi arIhaRAdi॰ vuY । OdaYcanaka maRikasya sannikfzwadeSAdua tri॰ ।
m: औदञ्चन mfn. (fr. उद्-अञ्चन), contained in a bucket, BhP.
औदञ्चनक mfn. relating to a bucket g. अरीहणादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.
औदञ्चवि m. a descendant of Udañcu g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96.

v: puMstrI udaYcApatyam iY । 1 udaYcApatye tataH yUni PiY pElA॰ tasya luk । 2 tadIyayuvApatye'pi ।

m: औदबुद्धि m. a descendant of Udabuddha g. पैलादि, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 59.
औदज्ञायनि m. a descendant of Udajña [Kāś. reads उदन्य] g. तिकादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 154.
औदका f. a town surrounded by water, Hariv. 6874.
औदकीय m. a king of the Audakis, ib.

v: tri॰ udakena pUrRaM gfhRAti udakasyedaM vA aR । 1 udakapUrRakumBagrAhake “apareRAgnimOdako'nusaMvrajya pARigrAhaM mUrdDvadeSe'vasiYcati” goBilaH । “Odako gfhItodakumBaH” saM॰ ta॰ raGu॰ । 2 udakasambanDini । “OdakenEva viDinA nirvapet dakziRAmuKaH” manuH । udake BavaH aR । 3 jalaBave ca । “yAni cEvaM prakArARi sTalajAnyOdakAni ca” “sTalajOdakaSAkAni puzpamUlaPalAni ca” manuH
m: औदक mf(ई)n. (fr. उदक), living or growing in water, relating to water, aquatic, watery, Lāṭy.; Mn.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
a: औदक — a. (की f.) [उदक-अण्] Aquatic, watery, referring to water; ˚ज produced by aquatic plants.

m: औदक—ज mfn. coming from aquatic plants, Suśr.

v: puMstrI “udaNka udaka (saMjYAyAm)” pA॰ ga॰ vAhvA॰ apatye iY । udakanAmarzerapatye tataH svArTe dAmanyA॰ Ca । OdakIya tatrArTe । evam OdaNki OdaNkIya ityapi udaNkApatye puMstrI ।
m: औदकि m. a descendant of Udaka g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96
m. pl. N. of a warrior tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 3, 116.

v: tri॰ cikitagAlavakAlavavamanutantukuqilAnAM vESvAmitradevarAtOdaleti” A॰ SrO॰ 12, 14, 2, ukte cikitAdInAM zaRRAM pravararziBede ।
m: औदल m. a descendant of Udala, ĀśvŚr.
औदल n. N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
औदमज्जि m. a descendant of Uda-majja, ib.
औदम्बरी f. (with संहिता) N. of a wk. on Bhakti (accord. to Nimbārka).

v: tri॰ udameGeridam rEvatikAdi॰ Ca । OdameDi sambanDini ।

m: औदमेघीय mfn. belonging to Audameghi [v.l. औदमेयि, Kāś.] g. रैवतकादि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 131.
औदमेघ m. pl. the school of Audameghyā, Pat.
औदमेघि m. a descendant of Uda-megha, ib.
औदमेघ्या f. of औदमेघि above, Pat.

v: puMstrI udameyasyApatyam iY । udameyasyApatye tataH manuzyajAtitvAt striyAM NIz ।

s: tri, (odanaM Silpamasya । odana + WaY .) sUpakAraH । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ odanAya praBavati saMtApA॰ WaYu । odananizpAdanAya samarTe sUpakAre ।
m: औदनिक mf(ई)n. (fr. ओदन), one who knows how to cook mashed grain g. संतापादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 101.
a: औदनिकः — [ओदनाय प्रभवति ठञ्] 1 A cook, (one who knows how to cook). --2 One to whom rice or mashed grain is given at regular times.

k.v: आरालिका आन्धसिकाः सूदा औदनिका गुणाः। आपूपिकः कान्दविको भक्ष्यकार इमे त्रिषु॥

m: औदन्वत mfn. (fr. उदन्वत्), relating to the sea, marine, Bālar.
औदन्वत m. a descendant of Udanvat, Kāś. on Pāṇ. viii, 2, 13.
औदन्यायनि m. a descendant of Udanya g. तिकादि [Kāś.], Pāṇ. iv, 1, 154.

v: pu॰ udanyAyukte fzO BavaH aR । pipAmAyukta rziBave muRqiBe fzO । “etAM ha vE muRqiBa OdanyaH brahmahatyAyE prAyaScittiM vidAYcakAra” Sata॰ brA॰ 23, 3, 5, 6 । tasyApatye tu iY । Odanyi ityeva tatrArTe tataH yuvapratyayasya PiYaH pElA॰ luk । tadIyayuvApatye ca ।
m: औदन्य m. (fr. उदन्य), N. of the Ṛṣi Muṇḍibha, ŚBr. xiii.
औदन्यव m. (fr. उदन्यु) id., TBr. iii.
औदन्यि m. id. g. पैलादि, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 59 [not in Kāś.]

v: tri॰ udapAnAdAgataH SuRqikA॰ aR । AyasTAnarUpodapAnAdAgate 1 rAjagrAhyakarAdO । udapAne BavaH paladyA॰ aR । 2 udapAnanAmagrAmaBave karAdO tri॰ । udapAne jalADArasTAnaBede BavaH utsA॰ aY । 3 udapAnaBave tri॰ । striyAM sarvatra NIp ।
m: औदपान mf(ई)n. (fr. उद-पान), raised from wells or drinking fountains (as a tax &c.)
belonging or relating to a well
coming from the village Udapāna, gaṇas on Pāṇ.
a: औदपान — a. (नी f.) [उदपानादागतः अण्] Raised from wells or drinking fountains (as a tax).

m: औदर mfn. (fr. उदर), being in the stomach or belly, Suparṇ.
gastric (as a disease), Hcat.
औदर्चिष mfn. directed to Agni, Śiś.

s: tri, (udare prasitaH । udara + Wak .) vijigIzAvivarjjitaH । udaramAtrapUrakaH । pewuka iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । AdyUnaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA kirAte । 11 । 5 Slokasya wIkAyAM mallinATaH । “ataevAdyUna OdarikaH । AdyUnaH syAdOdarike vidigozAvivarjjite । ityamaraH” ॥) “vijigIzAvyavahAraH kaScit prakarzo vA AlasyAt tena vihIno yaH kevalamudarADInaH” । iti BarataH ॥ “svodarapUraRASaktinimittakanindAtyAgecCA vijigIzA tayA rahitaH” । iti ramAnATaH ॥
v: tri॰ udare prasitaH Wak । AdyUne, (peyaka) udaramAtrapUraRApekzake । “ESvaryyavantaM rOdraM ca SUra caRqamasUyakam । ekASinamOdarikamAsuraM satvamIdfSam” suSrute tasyAsurasatvatvamuktam । amare vijigIzAvivarjjitasya taTAtvamuktam । vijigIzA ca vigAnecCA sA ca svodarapUraRAsaktatayA nindecCA tasyAHtyAga evAsya pravfttiH । “sarvvamevOdarikasyAByavahAryyAya kalpate” nAwa॰
m: औदरिक mf(ई)n. gluttonous, a belly-god, glutton, Pāṇ.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
greedy
fit for or pleasant to the stomach (as food), Lalit.
dropsical, Hcat.
a: औदरिक — a. (की f.) [उदरे एव प्रसितः ठक्] Voracious, gluttonous: a glutton; सर्वत्रोदरिकस्याभ्यवहार्यमेव विषयः V. 3; M. 4.

k.v: आद्यूनः स्यादौदरिको विजिगीषाविवर्जिते। उभौ त्वात्मम्भरिः कुक्षिम्भरिः स्वोदरपूरके॥

m: औदर्य mfn. being in the stomach or belly
being in the womb, BhP.
a: औदर्य — a. [उदरे भवः यत्] 1 Being in the womb. --2 Entered into the womb.

v: tri॰ udare BavaH yat udaryyaH tataHsvArTe aR । 1 udaraBave'nalAdO । 2 aByantarapravizwe ca । “sa tvayArADitaH Suklovitanvan mAmaka yaSaH । CettA te hfdayagranTimOdaryyo brahmaBAvanaH” BAga॰ 3, 24, 5 ।
tri॰ udasTAnaM SIlamasya CatrA॰ Ra । 1 udasTAnaSIle । udasTAne mavaH utsA॰ aY । 2 udakasTAnaBave ca ।
m: औदस्थान mfn. (fr. उद-स्थान), accustomed to stand in water
relating to one who stands in water, gaṇas on Pāṇ.
a: औदस्थान — a. (नी f.) [उदस्यान-णं] Accustomed to stand in water.

v: pu॰ udavAhasyApatyam iY । fgvedinAm prAcInAvItitayA tarpaRIyarziBede । dvAdaSarzitarpaRAnantaram । “prArcAnIvItI” “sumantujEminivESampAyanapElasUtraBAzyaBAratamahABArataGarmBAcAryAjAnantibAhavigArgyagOtamaSAkalyabAmravyamARqavyamARqukeyA gArgI vAcaknavI baqavA prAcITeyI sulaBA mEtreyI kaholaM kOzItakaM pENgyaM mahApENgyaM suyajYaM sANKyAyanamEtareyaM mahEtareyaM SAkalaM bAzkalaM sujAtavaktramOdavAhiM mahOdavAhiM sOjAmiM SOnakamASvalAyanaM ye cAnye AcAryyAste sarve tfpyantviti” ASva॰ gf॰ 3, 4, 4, “trayoviMSati vAkyAti tatra kaholAdizu arTAt tarpayAmItiSabdaH kAryyaH । sarvvatra prativAkyaM tarpaRaNkuryyAt “ekamantrARi karmmARIti” nyAyAt” nArA॰ । “OdavAheSca SARqilyAcca SARqilyaH” Sata॰ brA॰ 14, 7, 3, 26, vaMSavarRRane
m: औदवाहि m. a descendant of Uda-vāha, ŚBr.; ĀśvGṛ.
औदवापीय mfn. relating to Audavāpi, ib.

v: puMstrI udavApasyApatyam iY । udabApApatye striyAM NIp । tasyedaM rEvatikA॰ Ca । OdavApIya tat sambanDini tri॰ ।
m: औदवापि m. a descendant of Uda-vāpa g. रैवतिकादि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 131 (Kāś. reads औदवाहि).
औदव्रज mf(ई)n. composed by Uda-vraja.
औदव्रजि m. a descendant of Uda-vraja, VBr.

a: औदयकाः — (pl.) A school of astronomers who reckoned the first motion of the planets from sunrise (उदय).

m: औदयक m. pl. (fr. उद्-अय), a school of astronomers (who reckoned the first motion of the planets from sunrise).
औदयन mfn. relating to or coming from (the teacher) Udayana, Sarvad.

v: tri॰ udaye lagnakAle BavaH WaY । lagnakAlaBave striyAM NIp ।
m: औदयिक mfn. to be reckoned from sunrise
relating to or happening in an auspicious time, prosperous, T.
(with भाव, the state of the soul when actions arise, Sarvad.)
a: औदयिक — a. (की f.) [उदय-ठञ्] One of the five different states of the soul (with Jainas), when actions arise and exert an inherent influence on the future.

m: औद्बिल्य n. (fr. उद्-बिल), excessive joy, Buddh.
औद्दालकायन m. a descendant of Auddālaki, Pat.

s: klI, (uddAlena kIwena saYcitam । uddAla+ aR + saMjYAyAM kan .) valmIkakArikIwanirmmitamaDu । tasya guRAH । kazAyatvam । uzRatvam । kawutvam । kuzWavizaroganASitvaYca । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ (aTOddAlakasya lakzaRaM guRASca yaTA । “prAyo valmIkamaDyasTAH kapilAH svalpakIwakAH । kurvvanti kapilaM svalpaM tat syAdOddAlakaM maDu ॥ OddAlakaM rucikaraM svaryyaM kuzWavizApaham । kazAyamuzRamamlaYca kawupAkaYca pittakft” ॥ iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe dvitIye BAge ॥ tIrTaviSezaH । yaduktaM mahABArate 3 । 84 । 151 । “OddvAlakaM mahArAja tIrTaM muninizevitam । tatrABizekaM kftvA vE sarvvapApEH pramucyate” ॥
v: na॰ uddAlena uddalanena nirvfttaH aR saMjYAyAM kan । “prAyo valmIkamaDyasTAH kapilAH svalpakIwakAH । kurbanti kapilaM svalpaM tat syAdOddAlakaM maDu” ityukte valmIkakIwasamBfte maDuni “OddAlakaM rucikaraM svaryyaM kuzWavizApaham । kazAyamuzRamamlaYca kawupAkaYca pittakft” tadguRA vEdyakoPAH jYeyAH ।
m: औद्दालक n. (fr. उद्-दालक), a kind of honey (taken from certain bees which live in the earth), Bhpr.; Suśr.
N. of a Tīrtha, MBh. iii.
a: औद्दालकं — [उद्दालेन निर्वृत्तं अण् संज्ञायां कन्] A bitter and acrid substance like honey; प्रायो वल्मीकमध्यस्याः कपिलाः स्वल्पकीटकाः . कुर्वति कपिलं स्वल्पं तत्स्यादौद्दालकं मधु ...

v: puMstrI uddAlakasyarzerapatyas iY । uddAlakApatye gOtame fzO striyAM manuzyajAtitvAt NIza । tataH yUni Pak । OddAlakAyana tadIyayuvApatye prAcyaBarate tu vahvackatvAt tasya bahuzu luk । uddAlakAH । tadIyayuvApatyAni prAcyAni BAratAni vA
m: औद्दालकि m. a descendant of Uddālaka, N. of several men, TS.; ŚBr.; KaṭhUp.; MBh.

v: tri॰ uddaRqasya sannikfzwadeSAdi arIhaRA॰ vuY । uddaRqasannikfzwadeSAdO ।
m: औद्दण्डक mfn. (fr. उद्-दण्ड), relating to one who holds up a staff g. अरीहणादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 80.
औद्देशिक mfn. (fr. उद्-देश), pointing out, indicative of, showing, enumerating, Nir.
prepared for the sake of (mendicants; said of alms), Jain.
a: औद्देशिक — a. (की f.) [ उद्देशठक्] 1 Showing, indicative of. --2 Enumerating.

v: puMstrI udagAhamAnasyApatyam iY tatoyUni Pak tasya pElA॰ luk । 1 udgAhamAnasyApatye 2 tadIye yuvApatye ca striyAM gOrA॰ NIz । tato mavAdO gahA॰ Ca । OdgAhamAnIya tadBavAdO tri॰ ।
m: औद्गाहमानि m. a descendant of Udgāhamāna, Gobh.

v: na॰ udgAturDarmmyam fdantatvAt aY । udgAtuH ftvigBedasya 1 Darmmye “svarityOdgAtra AhavanIye” kAtyA॰ 25, 1, 8, udgAtfvedavihite Breze svarityAhavanIye juhoti” karkaH । udgAtuH karmma mAvo vA udgAtrA॰ aR । udgAtuH uccErgAnAtmake 2 karmmaRi 3 tadBAve ca ।
m: औद्गात्र mfn. relating to the Udgātṛ priest, KātyŚr. Comm. on BṛĀrUp. &c.
औद्गात्र n. the office of the Udgātṛ priest, Pāṇ. v, 1, 129.
a: औद्गात्रं — [उद्गातृ-अञ् अण् वा] The office of the Udgātṛ priest.

m: औद्गात्र—सार-संग्रह m. N. of wk.

v: tri॰ udgrahaRAya sADu aR vedehasya BaH । UrdDvagrahaRasADane “sarvARi ha vE dIkzAyAyajUMzyOdgraBaRAni” udgfBnIte vA ezo'smAllokAddevalokamaBi yaddIkzate” Sata॰ brA॰ 3, 1, 4, 1, “OdgraBaRAni juhoti sTAlyAH sruveRAkftyA iti pratimantram” kAtyA॰ 7, 3, 16 । BatvABAve OdgrahaRamapyatra ।
m: औद्ग्रभण अम्, n. (fr. उद्-ग्रभण), N. of a particular offering, MaitrS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
औद्ग्रभण—त्व n. the being such an offering, MaitrS.
औद्ग्रहण n. id., TS. vi.
औद्रायण m. (for Prākṛt Uddāyaṇa) N. of a prince, HPariś. xiii, 1.

a: औदुंबर — a. (री f.) [उदंबर-अञ्] Made of, or coming from, the Udumbara tree --रः 1 N. of a region abounding in Udumbara trees. --2 A form of Yama, the god of death. --री A branch of the Udumbara tree. --रं 1 The wood of the Udumbara tree. --2 The Udumbara fruit. --3 A kind of leprosy. --4 Copper.
औदुंबरकः — A place full of Udumbara trees.

v: puMstrI udumbarasya gotrApatyam naqA॰ Pak । udumbarasya gotrApatye । anantarApatyetu iY । Odumbari tadIyAnantarApatye puMstrI striyAM NIp ।
m: औदुम्बरायण m. a descendant of Udumbara, N. of a grammarian.
a married Brāhman, L.
औदुम्बरायणि m. a descendant of the last.
औदुम्बरी f. (with and without शाखा) a branch of the Udumbara tree, ŚBr. : Lāṭy.; Nyāyam. &c.
a kind of musical instrument
औदुम्बरी f. (with संहिता) N. of a wk. on Bhakti (accord. to Nimbārka).
औदुम्बर mf(ई)n. (in class. Sanskṛt commonly written औडु˚) (fr. उद् [ड्] उम्बर), coming from the tree Udumbara or Ficus Religiosa, made of its wood, AV.; ŚBr.; Mn. ii, 45; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
made of copper, SāmavBr. ii, 5, 3
औदुम्बर m. a region abounding in Udumbara trees, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 67
a kind of worm, Car.
N. of Yama
औदुम्बर m. pl. N. of a race, MBh.
औदुम्बर m. of a class of ascetics, Hariv. 7988; BhP. iii, 12, 43
औदुम्बर n. an Udumbara wood, KātyŚr.
a piece of Udumbara wood, PārGṛ.
the fruit of the Udumbara tree, AitBr.
a kind of leprosy, Suśr.
copper, L.
औदुम्बर—च्छद m. Croton Polyandrum, Nigh.

v: pu॰ udumbarasya vizayodeSaH rAjanyA॰ vuY । 1 udumbaravizaye deSe । tasya sasUha ityaDikArAt rAjanyA॰ vuY । 2 tatsamUhe na॰ ।
m: औदुम्बरक m. the country inhabited by the Udumbaras g. राजन्यादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 53.
औदुम्बर—ता f.
औदुम्बर—त्व n. the state of being made of the Udumbara tree, Nyāyam.
औदुम्बरि m. a king of the Udumbaras Comm. on Pāṇ.

s: klI, (udvAhasamaye labDam । udvAha + WaY .) BAryyAprAptikAle labDaM BAryyADanam । iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ tat BrAtfBiraviBAjyam । yaTA । “pitfdravyAvinASena yadanyat svayamarjjayet । mEtramOdvAhikaYcEva dAyAdAnAM na tadBavet ॥ iti yAjYavalkyaH ॥ (yaTA ca manuH । 9 । 206 । “vidyADanantu yadyasya tattasyEva DanaM Bavet । mEtramOdvAhikaYcEva mADuparkikameva ca” ॥)
v: tri॰ udvAhakAle labDaM dIyate vA WaY । vivAhakAle 1 labDe dIyamAneca “vidyADanantu yadyasya tattasyEva DanaM Bavet! mEtryamOdvAhikaYcEva mADuparkikameva ca” smftiH “pitfdravyAvinASena yadanyat svayamarjjayet । mEtramOdDAhikaYcEva dAyAdAnAM na tadBavet” yAjYa॰ । tatsarvvEraviBAjyam ।
m: औद्वाहिक mfn. (fr. उद्-वाह), relating to or given at marriage, Mn. ix, 206; Yājñ. ii, 118.
a: औद्वाहिक — a. (की f.) [उद्वाह-ठञ्] 1 Relating to marriage. --2 Obtained in marriage; Y. 2. 118; Ms. 9. 206. --कं A gift made to a woman at her marriage.

v: tri॰ udvepa + caturaryyAm saNkalA॰ aR । udvepena 1 nirvftte 2 tatsannikfzwadeSAdO ca
m: औद्वेप mfn. (fr. उद्-वेप, g. संकलादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 75), resulting from tremor or trembling (?).

v: tri॰ udyAvasya vyAKyAnogranTaH tatra Bavo vA fgayanA॰ aR । 1 udyAvavyAKyAnagranTe 2 tatra Bave ca ।
m: औद्याव mf(ई)n. (fr. उद्याव, g. ऋगयनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 73), treating of the art of mixing or joining (?).
औग्रसैन्य m. id., N. of Yudhāṃśrauṣṭi, AitBr. viii, 21, 7.
औग्रसेनि m. a descendant of Ugra-sena, BhP.
औग्रसेन्य m. id., Pat. on Vārtt. 7 on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 114.
औग्रेय m. a descendant of Ugra g. शुभ्रादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 123.
औग्र्य n. (fr. उग्र), horribleness, dreadfulness, fierceness, Sāh.
a: औग्र्यं — [उग्र ष्यञ्] Formidableness, fierceness, dreadfulness, cruelty &c.

m: औजस n. (fr. ओजस्), gold, L.
N. of a Tīrtha (v.l. औसज), Viṣṇ.
a: औजसं — Gold.

v: tri॰ ojasA varttate Wak । SUre tejasvini
m: औजसिक mfn. energetic, vigorous, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 27.
a: औजसिक — a. (की f.) [ओजसा वर्तते ठक्] Energetic, vigorous, acting. with strength. --कः A hero.

v: na॰ ojas + svArTezyaY । ojasi । “dOrgatyAdyE ranOjasyaM dEnyaM malinatAdikft” sA॰ da॰ ।
m: औजस्य mfn. conducive to or increasing vitality or energy, Suśr.
औजस्य n. vigour, energy, Sāh.
a: औजस्य — a. Conducive to vigour or energy. --स्यं Strength, vigour of life, energy.

m: औज्जागरि (see सुन्दर-मिश्र, p. 1227).

v: tri॰ ujjayinyAM jAtAdi DUmA॰ vuY । ujjayinonagarajAtAdO ।
m: औज्जयनक mfn. relating to or coming from the town Ujjayanī g. धूमादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 127.
औज्जयनिक m. a king of Ujjayanī, VarBṛS.

v: puMstrI ujjihAnasyApatyamata iY । ujjinApatye tataH iYantatvAt yUni Pak pElAdi॰ tasya luk । tadIyayuvApatye'pi ।
m: औज्जिहानि m. a descendant of Ujjihāna g. पैलादि, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 59.
औज्ज्वल्य n. (fr. उज्-ज्वल), brightness, brilliancy, Mālatīm.
splendour, beauty, Sāh.; Vām.; Daśar. &c.
a: औज्ज्वल्यं — [उज्ज्वल-ष्यञ्] Brightness, brilliancy.

m: औ—कार m. the letter or sound औ, TPrāt.; APrāt.

v: tri॰ ukTa--gargA॰ apatyeyaY OkTyaH tasya cCAtraH kaRvAdi॰ aR yaYoluk । OkTyacCAtre
m: औक्थ m. a descendant or pupil of Aukthya g. कण्वादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 111.
a: औक्थं — A peculiar mode of recitation.

v: tri॰ ukTaM sAmAvayavaBedaM vettyaDIte vA Wak । 1 ukTADyAyini 2 tadvettari ca । tezAM Darmma AmnAyAvA tataH Yya । OkTya OwTikAnAM Darmme tadAmnAye ca na॰ ।
m: औक्थिक mfn. one who knows or studies the Ukthas, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 129.
a: औक्थिकः — [उक्थ-ठक्] A Brāhmaṇa who knows or studies or recites the ukthas.

m: औक्थिक्य n. the tradition of the Aukthikas, ib.
a: औक्थिक्यं — The text of the Ukthas.

m: औक्थ्य m. a descendant of Uktha g. गर्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 105
औक्थ्य n. See महद्-औक्थ्य.
औक्ष्ण (ŚBr. i) and औक्ष्ण (ŚBr. xiv), mfn. relating to or coming from a bull
(अस्), m. a descendant of Ukṣan, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 173.

v: na॰ ukzRAM vfzARAM samUhaH aR wilopaH । 1 vfzasamUhe । vuY । Okzaka tatsmUhe na॰ । tasyedamaR wilopaH । 2 vfzasambanDini tri॰ । apatye aRi tu OkzRa ityeva । vede kvacit idamarTe'Ri upaDAtolopaH । “tAmOkzREScaruBiH paScAt” Sata॰ brA॰ 1, 2, 5, 2 ।
m: औक्ष mf(ई)n. (fr. उक्षन्) coming from or belonging to a bull, AV. ii, 36, 7; Kauś.; Pāṇ. vi, 4, 173
औक्ष (अम्), n. a multitude of bulls, L.
औक्षण m. a descendant of Ukṣan.
औक्ष—गन्धि f. N. of an Apsaras, AV. iv, 37, 3.

s: klI, ukzRAM samUhaH । (“gotrokzozwroraBreti” । 4 । 2 । 39 ॥ vuY .) vfzasamUhaH । ityamaraH ॥ e~qe garura pAla iti BAzA ॥

samBavati । yata upadizwe'pi vihite'pyaSakyaopAye sa upadeSo na Bavati । kintUpadeSABAsa eva “bADitamarTaM vedo'pi na boDayatIti” nyAyAdityarTaH” BA॰ । atra SaNkate । “SuklapawavadvIjavaccet” sU॰ । “nanu svABAvikasyApyapAyo dfSyate । yaTA Suklapawasya svABAvikaM SOklyaM rAgeRApanIyate । yaTA ca vojasya svABAvikyapyaNkuraSaktiragninApanIyate । ataH Suklapawa vadbIjavacca svABAvikasya banDasyApyapAyaH puruze samBavatIti tadvadeva tatsADanopadeSaH syAditi cedityarTaH” BA॰ samADatte । “SaktyudBavAnudBavAByAM nASakyopadeSaH” sU॰ । “uktadfzwAntayorapi nASakyAya svABAvikAyopa deSo lokAnAM mavati । kutaH SaktyadBavAnudBavAByAm dfzwAntadvaye hi SOklyAderAvirBAvatiroBAvAveva BavataH na tu SOklyANkuraSaktyoraBAvo Bavati । rajakAdivyApArEryogisaNkalpAdiBiSca raktapawaBfzwavIjayoH punaH SOklyANkuraSaktyAvirBAvAdityarTaH । nanvevaM puruze'pi duHKaSaktitiroBAva eva mokzo'stviti cenna duHKAtyantanivfttereva loke puruzarTatvAnumAnAt SrutismftyoH puruzArTatvasidDeSca na tu dfzwAntayoriva tiroBAvamAtrasyeti । kiYca duHKaSaktitirIBAvamAtrasya mokzatve kadAcidyIgISvarasaNkalpAdinA SaktyudBavasya BfzwavIjezviva muktezvapi samBavenAnirmokzApattiriti” mA॰ । svaBAvato banDaM nirAkftya nimitteByo'pi banDamapAkaroti sUtrajAtena । puruze duHKasya nEmittikatve jYAnAdyupAyocCedyatvaM na Gaweta । anAgatAvasTasUkzmaduHKasya yAvaddravyaBAvitvAdityASayena nEmittikatvaM nirAkriyate । “na kAlayogato vyApino nityasya sarvasambanDAt” sU॰ । “nApi kAlasambanDanimittakaH puruzasya banDaH kutaH? vyApino nityasya kAlasya sarvvAvacCedena sarvvadA muktAmuktasakalapuruzasambanDAt sarvvAvacCedena sadA sakalapuruzARAM banDAzatterityarTaH । atra ca prakaraRe kAladeSakarmAdInAM nimittatvasAmAnyaM nApalapyate SrutismftiyuktimiH sidDatvAt । kintu yannEmittikatvaM pAkajarUpAdivannimittajanyatvaM tadeba banDe pratiziDyate puruze banDasyOpADikatvAByupagamAt । nanu kAlAdinimittakatve'pi sahakAryantarasamBavAsamBavAByAM vyavasTA syAditi cet evaM sati yatsaMyoge satyavaSyaM banDastatrEva sahakaHriRi lAGavAdbanDo yuktaH puruze banDavyavahArasyOpADikatvenApyupapatteriti kftaM nEmittikatveneti” BA॰ “na deSayogato'pyasmAt” sU॰ । “deSayogato'pi na banDaH kutaH? asmAt pUrvvasUtroktAnmuktAmuktasarvvapuruzasambanDAt muktasyApi banDApatterityarTaH” BA॰ । “nAvasTAto dehaGarmatvAt tasyAH” sU॰ । “saNGAtaviSezarUpatAKyA deharUpA yAvasTA na tannimicato'pi puruzasya banDaH । kutaH? tasyA avasTAyA dehaDarmatvAt acetanaDarmatvAdityarTaH । anyaDarmasya sAkzAdanyabanDakatve'tiprasaNgAt । muktasyApi banDApatterityarTaH” BA॰ । nanu puruzasyApyavasTAyAM kiM bADakaM tatrAha । “asaNgo'yaM puruza iti” sU॰ । “iti Sabdo hetvarTe । puruzasyAsaNgatvAdavasTAyA dehamAtraDarmatvamiti pUrvasUtreRAnvayaH । puruzasyAvasTArUpavikArasvIkAre vikArahetusaMyogAKyaH saNgaH prasajyeteti BAvaH । asaNgatve ca SrutiH । “sa yadatra kiYcit paSyatyananvAgatastena Bavati asaNgo hyayaM puruza” iti । saNgaSca saMyogamAtraM na Bavati । kAladeSasambanDasya pUrvamuktatvAt । Sratismftizu padmapatrasTajaleneva padmapatrasyAsaNgatAyAH puru zAsaNgatAyAM dfzwAntatASravaRAcca” BA॰ । “na karmaRAnyaDarmatvAdatiprasakteSca” sU॰ । “na hi bihitanizidDakarmaRApi puruzasya banDaH karma RAmanAtmaDarmatvAt । anyaDarmeRa sAkzAdanyasya banDe ca muktasyApi banDApatteH । nanu svasvopADikarmaRA banDANgIkAre nAyaM doza ityASayena hetvantaramAha । atiprasakteSceti । pralayAdAvapi duHKayogarUpabanDApatteScetyarTaH । saha kAryyantaravilambato vilambakalpanaM ca prAgeva nirAkftaM na kAlayogata ityAdisUtra iti” BA॰ । nanvevaM duHKayegarUpo'pi banDaH karmasAmAnADikaraRyAnuroDena cittasyEvAstu duHKasya cittaDarmatAyAH sidDatvAt । kimarTaM puruzasyApi kalpyate banDa ityASaNkAyAmAha “vicitraBogAnupapattiranyaDarmatve” sU॰ । “duHKayogarUpabanDasya cittamAtraDarmatve vicitraBogAnupapattiH । puruzasya hi duHKayogaM vinApi duHKasAkzAtkArAKyaBogasvIkAre sarvvapuruzaduHKAdInAM sarvapuruzaBogyatA syAnniyAmakABAvAt । tataScAyaM duHKaBoktAyaM ca suKaBoktetyAdirUpaBIgavEcitryaM nopapadyetetyarTaH । ato BogavEcitryopapattaye BoganiyAmakatayA duHKAdiyogarUpo banDaH puruze'pi svIkAryaH । sa ca puruze duHKayogaH prativimbarUpa eveti prAgevoktam । prativimbaSca svopADivfttereva BavatIti na sarvapuMsAM sarvaduHKaBogaH iti BAvaH । “cittavfttiBoge ca puruzasyAnAdiH svasvAmiBAvaH sambanDo heturiti” yogaBAzyAdayaM sidDAntaH sidDaH । citte ca puruzasya svatvaM svaBuktavfttivAsanAvattvamiti । yata ta cittasyEva banDamokzO na puruzasyeti Srutismftizu gIyate tadvimbarUpaduHKayogarUpaM pAramArTikaM banDamAdAya boDyam” BA॰ । sAkzAt prakftinimittakatvamapi banDasyApAkaroti । “prakftinibanDanAccenna tasyA api pAratantryam” sU॰ । “nanu prakftinimittAdbanDo Bavatviti cenna yatastasyA api banTakatve saMyogapAratantryamuttaratra vakzyamARamasti । saMyogaviSezaM vinApi banDakatve pralayAdAvapi duHKasambanDaprasaNgAdityarTaH । prakftinibanDanA cediti pAWe tu prakftinibanDanA cedbadDatetyarTaH” BA॰ । ato yatparatantrA prakftirbanDakAraRaM samBavet tasmAdeva saMyogaviSezAdOpADiko banDo'gnisaMyogAjjalOzRyavaditi svasidDAntamanenEva prasaNgenAntarAla evAvaDArayati । “na nityaSudDabudDamuktasvaBAvasya tadyogastadyogAdfte” sU॰ । “tasmAt tadyogAdfte prakftisaMyogaM vinA na puruzasya tadyogo banDasamparko'sti । api tu sa eva banDahetuH । banDasyOpADikatvalABAya naYdvayena vakrokti । yadi hi banDaH prakftisaMyogajanyaH syAt pAkajarUpavat tadA tadbadeba tadviyoge'pyanuvartteta । na ca dvitIyakzaRAderduHKanASakatvaM kalpyaM kAraRanASasya kAryanASakatAyAH kxptatvena tenEvopapattAvaDikA'kalpanAt । vfttirhi duHKAderupAdAnam । ato dIpaSiKAvat kzaRaBadBurAyA vftterASuvinASitvenEva tadDarmARAM duHKecCAdInAM vinASaH samBavatIti । ataH prakftiviyoge banDABAvAdOpADika eva banDo na tu svABAviko nEmittiko veti । taTA tatsaMyoganivfttireva sAkzAdDAnopAya ityapi vakroktiPalam । taTA ca smftiH “yaTA jvaladgfhASlizwaM gfhaM vicCidya rakzyate । taTA sadozaprakftivicCinno'yaM na Socati” । vESepikARAmiva pAramArTiko duHKayoga iti Bramo mA BUdityetadarTaM nityetyAdi । yaTA svaBAvaSudDasya sPawikasya rAgayogo na japAyogaM vinA Gawate taTEva nityaSudDAdisvaBAvasya puruzasyopADisaMyogaM vinA duHKasaMyogo na Gawate svato duHKAdyasamBavAdityarTaH taTAha sOre “yaTA hi kevalo raktaH sPawiko lakzyate janEH” । raYjakAdyupaDAnena tadvat paramapUruzaH” । nityatvaM kAlAnavacCinnatvam । SudDAdisvaBAvatvaM ca nityaSudDatvAdikam । tatra nityaSudDatvaM sadA pApapuRyaSUnyatvam । nityabudDatvamaluptacidrUpatvam । nityamuktatvaM sadA pAramArTikaduHKAyuktatvam । prativimbarUpaduHKayogastvapAragArTiko banDaH iti BAvaH । Atmano nityaSudDatvAdO ca SrutiH । “ayamAtmA sanmAtro nitya SudDaH budDaH satyo mukto niraYjano viBurityAdiH” BA॰ । ayameva pakzo vedAntiBirapyaNgIkftaH “tadguRasAratvAdityAdi” SA॰ sUtraBAzye “na hi budDerguRErvinA kevalasyAtmanaH saMsAritvamasti budDyupADiDarmmADyAsanimittaM hi karttftvaBoktftvalakzaRaM saMsAritvamakartturaBoktuScAsaMsAriRonityamuktasya sata AtmanaH” iti “yAvadAtmaBAvitvAdityAdi” SA॰ sUtraBAzye ca “yAvadeva cAyaM budDyupADisambanDastAvadeva cAsya jIvatvaM saMsAritvaYca । paramArTatastu na jIvonAma budDyupADiparikalpitasvarUpavyatirekeRa” iti ca saMsAritvasya budDyupADisaMbanDADInatayOpADikatvasyokteH । ivAMstu viSezaH etanmate banDasyeva jIvaBedasyApi OpADikatvaM tadapi SAM॰ sU॰ BAzyayornirRRItaM yaTA “ataeva copamA(jala)suryyakAdivat” sU॰ “ataeva cAyamAtmA cEtanyasvarUponirviSezo vANmanasAtItaH parapratizeDenopadiSyate ataeva cAsyopADinimittAmapAramArTikIM viSezavattAmaBipretya jalasUryyakAdivadityupamopA dIyate mokzaSAstrezu “yaTAhyayaM jyotirAtmA vivasvAnapoBinnA bahuDEko'nugacCan । upADinA kriyate BedarUpodevaH kzetrezvevamajo'yamAtmeti” । “ekaeva tu BUtAtmA BUte BUte vyavasTitaH । ekaDA bahuDA cEva dfSyate jalacandravaditi cEvamAdizu । atra patyavasTIyate” BA॰ । “ambuvadagrahaRAttu na taTAtvam” sU॰ । “na jalasUryyAditulyatvamihopapadyate tadvadagrahaRAt । sUryyAdiByohi mUrtteByaH pfTagaBUtaM viprakfzwadeSaM mUrttaYca jalaM gfhyate tatra yuktaH sUryyAdiprativimbodayonatvAtmA mUrttaH nacAsmAt pfTagBUtA viprakfzwadeSAScopADayaH, sarvvagatatvAt sarvvAnanyatvAcca tasmAdayukto'yaM dfzwAnta iti । atra prativiDIyate । BA॰ “vfdDvihrAsamAtra mantarBAvAduBayasAmaYjasyAdevam” sU॰ । yukta eva tvayaM dfzwAntaH vivakzitAMSasamBavAt na hi dfzwAntadArzwAntikayoH kvacitkaYcidvivakzitamamaMSaM muktvA sarvvasArUpyaM kenaciddarSayituM Sakyate sarvvasArUpye hfi dfzwAntadArzwAntikaBAvocCeda eva syAt । na cedaM svamanIzayA jalasUryyakAdidfzwAntapraRaya nam । SAstrapraRItasya tvasya prayojanamAtramupanyasyate । kiMpunaratra vivakzitaM sArUpyamiti? taducyate vfdDihrAsamAtrami ti । jalagataM hi sUryyaprativimbaM jalavfdDO vardDate jalahrAse hrasate jalacalane calati jalaBede Bidyate ityevaM jalaDarmmAnuviDAyi Bavati na tu paramArTataH sUryyasya taTAtvamasti evaM paramArTato'vikftamekarUpamapi sadbyahma dehAdyupADyantarBAvAdBajataevopADiDarmmAn vfdDihnAsAdIn evamuBayordfzwAntadArzwAntikayoH sAmaYjasyAdaviroDaH” BA॰ । “darSanAcca” sU॰ । “darSayati ca SrutiH parasyEva brahmaRodehAdizu pADizvanupraveSam “puraH sa cakre dvipadaH puraScakre catuzpadaH । puraH sa pakzI BUtvA puraH puruza aviSaditi” “anena jIvenAtmanAnupraviSyeti” ca tadyuktametat” । upADireva vinayA॰ svArTe WaY । sADyasamavyApakatve sati sADanAvyApakatvarUpe prAgukte upADO “anOpADikovyAptiH”, anumA॰ ci॰ ।
m: औपाधिक mfn. (fr. उपाधि), relating to or depending on special qualities, limited by particular conditions, valid only under particular suppositions, Sarvad. Comm. on RV. & ŚBr. &c.
a: औपाधिक — a. (की f.) [ उपाधिठञ्] 1 Conditional. --2 Pertaining to attributes or properties; an effect produced.

m: औपाध्यायक mfn. (fr. उपाध्याय), coming from a teacher, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 77.
a: औपाध्यायक — a. (की f.) [ उपाध्याय-वुञ्] Coming or obtained from a teacher.

m: औपादानिक mfn. (fr. उपादान), effected by assuming or adopting.
औपाकरण mfn. (fr. उपाकरण), relating to the preparatory ceremony before beginning the study of the Veda
औपाकरण n. (अम्) the time of that ceremony, Āp. i, 10, 2.
