m: औपानह्य mfn. (fr. उपा-नह्), serving or used for making shoes, Pāṇ. v, 1, 14 (as grass or leather, Kāś.)
a: औपानह्य — a. [उपानह्-ञ्य] 1 Used for making shoes. --2 To be tied or bound on (as leather &c.).

m: औपानुवाक्य mfn. (fr. उपानुवाक्य), contained in the portion of the TS. called Upānuvākya, Jaim. v, 3, 15.
औपानुवाक्य—काण्ड n. = उपानुवाक्य Comm. on TS.

v: tri॰ upAsyate pratidinamityupAsano gfhyo'gnistatra BavaH aR । gfhyAgnO karttavye sAyaMprAtarhomAdO karmmaRi । gfhyAgniSca vivAhAgniH । tatra karttavyaM darSitaM “nOpAsanaSruteH” kAtyA 01, 1, 2, “yaduktam vEtAnikezvevAgnizuSrOtaM smArtaM ca karttavyamiti tanna kutaH? OpAsanaSruteH yata AhitAgnerapyOpAsanaH SrUyate pitfmeDe “advAreROpAsanaM nirasyatIti” yadi smArtamapi vEtAnikezveva kriyate tadA AhitAgneH pitfmeDe OpAsanadarSanaM na syAt asti ca । tasmAt smArttAnyOpAsane karttavyAnIti taTA ca smftiH smArttaM karmma vivAhAgnO kurvvIta pratyahaM gfhI । dAyakAlAhfte vApi SrOtaM vEtAnikAgnizviti” । “tasmin gfhyARItyApastambasmaraRAcca” । gfhAya hitaM gfhyam gfhaSabdaSca dampatyorvarttate tasminnityAvasaTye । ataSca yatkiYciddampatyorhitaM karma SAntika pOzwika vratANgahomAdikaM smArttaM tat sarvamAvasaTye'gnO BavatIti । taTA ca KAdiragfhyasUtrakArikAyAm “homAnAtmArTapatnyarTAn kftsnAnOpAsane na ca । parArTAnekadeSe'gnO sa cAnte lOkiko Bavet” ata eva kAtyAyanaH (karmapradApe) “na sve'gnAvanyahomaH syAnmuktvEkAM samidAhutim । svakarmma satkriyArTaSca yAvannAsO prajAyate । agnistu nAmaGeyAdO home sarvvatra lOkikaH । na hi pitrA samAnIta putrasya Bavati kvacit” । ataSca sImantonnayanamapi smArtAgnAveva kAryyam । apica ADAnenotpAditAnAM gArhapatyAdInAmagnInAm prayojanApekzAyAM satyAM “gArhapatye harvIzi SrapayatyAhavanIye juhoti dakziRAgnAvanvAhAryyaM pavatIti” pratyakzavacananirddizwEreva prayojanErnirAka NkzARAm na sAmarTyamAtreRoktAdanyatra viniyogaH kalpayituM Sakyate” । tasmAt smArtAnyOpAsana eva kAryyARi iti” karkaH । viDAnapA॰ tasyAramBakAlAdi nirUpitaM yaTA gfhyapariSizwe “aTa nityOpAsanaM tasya satayamAramBaM” iti । SOnako'pi yasminnahni vivAhaH syAtsAyamAraBya tasya tu । paricaryyAM vivAhAgnervidaDIta svayaM dvijaH । yadi rAtrO vivAhAgnirutpannaH syAttaTA sati । upakramottara syAhnaH sAyaM paricaredamumiti” । idamapi navanAqyatikramedfzwavyam । taTA cApastambasUtre BAzyakftsudarSanAcAryyaH । “asyacAramBaRaM rAtrAveva yadi nava nAqyonAtItAH । atItAScet paredyuH sAyamevAgnihotrabelAyAmAramBa iti” । anyatrApi । “prAtarhome saNgavAntaH kAlastvanudite 'Ta vA । sAyamastamite homaH kAlastu navanAqiketi” । atrAnuditahomakAlastu vAjasaneyinAM veditavyaH । taTA ca kAtyAyanasUtram । “OpAsanasya paricaraRamastamitAnuditayoriti” । tezAmOpAsanasamAramBo'pi caturTIhomAnantaramAhite'gnO Bavati na tu vivAhAgnO “AvasaTyADAnaM dArakAle dAyAdyakAle veti” kAtyAyanasUtrAt tadBAzyamapi । “dArakAlaScaturTyuttarakAlaH । dAyAdyakAloDanaviBAgakAla iti” OpAsanAtpUrvvaM yadi vivAhAgniH SAmyeta tadA prAyaScitamuktaM viSvAdarSe “udvAhOpAsanAt pUrvvamanale SAntimAgate । sTAlIpAkaM tataH kftvA hyOpAsanamaTAcaret । navanAqIBya UrddvaM cetsTAlIpAkoBavettu vE । OpAsane tadA kuryyAt paredyuH sAyamevaceti” । tasya prAduzkaraRakAla uktaH ASvalAyanasUtre “tasyAgnihItreRa prAduzkaraRahomamakAlO vyAKyAtAviti” tatkArikAyAmapi । “jvAlayedaparAhRe'gnimastaM yAte divAkare । paryyuhyAgniM paristIryya paryyukzya ca tataH paramiti” । spazwamAha kAtyAyanaH । “sUryye tu SElamaprApte zaqviMSadBirihANgulEH । pAduzkaraRamagnInAM prAtarAsomadarSanam” । taTA “duhitrA stuzayA vAgniviMhAro na viruDyate । nilepanaM ca pAtrARAmupalepanameva ceti” । uktakAle prAduzkaraRABAve prAyaScitta muktam ASvalAyana kArikAyAm । “prAyaScittaM viSezeRa yatra noktaM BavedbiDiH । hotavyAjyAhutistatra BUrBuvaHsvaritIti ceti” । kAtyAyanaH anuditAstamayalakzaRamAha । “rAtrestu zoqaSe BAge grahakzanatraBUzite । kAlaM tvanuditaM jYAtvA tatra homaM prakalpayet” । taTA “yAvatsamyaNgaBAsante naBasyfkzARi sarvataH । na ca lOhityamAyAti tAvatsAyaM tu hUyate” । atrASvalAyanAdInAM home muKyakAlamAha candrikAyAmatriH “hastAdUrdDvaM raviryAvadBUBiMhitvA na gacCati । tAvadDomaviDiH puRyonAnyo'ByuditahominAm । rAtrO pradozo muKyaHsyAditi vedavido viduriti” । atra gORakAlamAha SOnakaH “paScAdastamayAtkAloyoBavettrimUhUrttakaH । sa sAyaMhomakAlaHsyAt pradozAnta udAhftaH । yastu zaqnAqikAkAlaH paScAdevodayAdraveH । sa homakAlo viprARAM saNgavAnta iti smfta” iti । yadi gORakAlo'pyatotastadA gfhyapariSizweprAyaScittamuktam “nityahomamatItya manasvatyA caturgfhItaM juhuyAt dvAdaSUrAtrAdUrdDvaM punarADAnamiti” । kecittuprAyaScittaM kftvA prAtarhomakAlAt pUrvvaM sAyaMhomaH kAryyaH sAyaM homAtpUrvvaM prAtarhomaH kAryyEtyAhuH “AsAyakarmaRaH pAtarAprAtaH sAyakarmmaRaH । AhutiM nAtipadyeta pArvaRaM pArvaRAntarAditi” bODAyanasmfteriti । asyAgnihotravad viDAnaM pradarSitaM SOnakena । “agnihItravadityatecCOnakena prapaYcitam । punaH paryyukzya cANgArAnu dagagnerapohya ca । hOmyAnAM dvAdaSAnAM tu pakvametezwaDiMSrayet । payoyavAgUH sarpiSca odanaM daDi tuRqa lAH । somastElamapo vrIhirdvAdaSEte tilAyavAH । paya AdIni cacAri viduH pakvAni yAjYikAH । daDyAdInAmapakvAnAmaDiSrayaRamizyate । ulmukenEva jvalayedapakvaM pakvameva ca । aDiSrite snuveRApaH pariziYcennavADikAH । punastrirjvalatA tena parivyuhya prahftya tat । udarkkazaM triDodvAsyApyaNgArAnatisfjya ca । agneHpaScAttfRe zveva niDAya samiDA saha । trivAramekaM saMskftya gfhItvA sAyamagnaye (tezAM dvAdaSadravyARAM maDve ekaM dravyamityarTaH) । svAheti mantramuddAryya kurvvIta praTamaprAhutim! prAtarhome tu sUryyAya svAheti praTamAhutim । tUzRIM prajApatiM DyAyannuBayatra dvitIyikAmiti” । atrAnyoviSezaH svaSAKokto'vagantavyaH । homasTAnaM smftyarTasAre “bahuSuzke nDanenAgno susamidDe hutASane । aNgAre lelihAne ca hotavyaM nAnyaTA kvacit । yo'narcizi juhotyagnO vyaNgAre cEva mAnavaH । mandAgnirAmayAvIca daridraScopajAyate । agniH pradakziRAvarttaH SarmadaSca SuvAvahaH” iti । agnyupasTAnamantrAnAha SOnakaH “parisamuhya ca paryyukzyApyupatizWedDavirBujam । agneH sUktESca sOrESca prAjApatyEScanityaSaH” yAjYa॰ । hutvAgnIn sUryadevatyAn japenmantrAn samAhitaH” etadDomaM praSaMsatyaNgirAH “yaddadyAtkAYcanaM maruM pfTivIM ca sasAgarAm । tatsAyaM prAtarhomasya tulyaM Bavati vA naveti” । anyatrApi “nAgnihotrAtparoDarmmo nAgnihotrAtparaM tapaH । nagnihotrAtparaM snAnaM nAgnihotrAtparA gatiriti” akaraRe pratyavAyamAha garnaH “kftadArona tizWeta kzaRamapyagninA vinA । tizWeta cehijovrAtyastaTA ca patito Bavet । yaTA snAnaM yaTA sanDyA vedasyADyayanaM yaTA । tayEvOpAsanaM kAryyaM na sTitistadviyogataH । yo hi hitvA vivAhAgniM gfhasTa iti manyate । annaM tasya na BoktavyaM vfTApAkohi sa smftaH । vfTApAkasya BuYjAnaH prAyaScittaM samAcareta । prARAyAmaSataM kftvA GftaM prASya viSuDyatIti” । tasyASOce'pi karttavyatAmAha yAjYa॰ । “vEtAnOpAsanAH kAryyAH kriyASca SrutinodanAt” । NIbaBAva ArzaH loke tu OpAsanItyeva
m: औपासन m. (scil. अग्नि), (fr. उपासन), the fire used for domestic worship, ŚBr. xii; KātyŚr.; PārGṛ. &c.
(scil. पिण्ड) a small cake offered to the Manes, ŚāṅkhBr. & ŚāṅkhŚr.
औपासन mf(आ)n. relating to or performed at an Aupāsana fire (as the evening and morning oblations), Yājñ. iii, 17; HirGṛ.
a: औपासन — a. (नी f.) [उपासन-अण्] 1 Relating to गृह्याग्नि or household fire. --2 Belonging to worship or service, holy, sacred. --नः 1 A fire used for domestic worship. --2 A small rice-ball (पिंड) offered to the manes.

m: औपासन—प्रयोग m. the manner of performing the rites at the Aupāsana fire Comm. on ĀśvŚr.
औपासनिक m. the Aupāsana fire Comm. on ĀśvŚr.

v: puMstrI upAvasyApatyam iY । upAvarzerapatye “tatra OpAvinEva jAnaSrutAyanena pratyavarUQam” Sata॰ brA॰ 5, 1, 1, 5 । striyAM NIp ।
m: औपावि m. a descendant of Upāva, N. of Jānaśruteya, ŚBr. v.
औपायिक mfn. = औपयिक, q.v., MBh. v, 7019.
a: औपायिक — = औपयिक q. v.

v: tri॰ upaBUtA pAtreRa saYcitaH SEziko'l । 1 upaBftpAtreRa saYcite havirAdO । “brahmAnujYAto'nuyAjEstriBiScaratyOpaBftaM samAnIya” kAtyA॰ 3, 5, 2 avyaryyu rOpaBUtamAjyaM saSezaM juhvAM samAnIya” karkaH । tasyedam aR । 2 upaBftsambanDini “OpaBftAsAdanam” kAtyA॰ 5, 4, 28, OpaBftamupaBftsambanDyAsAdanam” karkaH । “savyA SroRirityOpaBftAni” kAtyA॰ 6, 7, 7 ।
m: औपभृत mfn. belonging to or being in the ladle called Upa-bhṛt, KātyŚr.; Jaim.
a: औपभृत — a. (ती f.) [उपभृत्-अल्] Being in the ladle (as an offering).

v: OpaDarmma + svArTe cAturva॰ zyaY । apakfzwaDarme । “lokAn DnatAM mativimohamatipraloBaM veSaM viDAya bahu BAzyata OpaDarmmyam” BAga॰ 2, 7, 78 ।

m: औपधर्म्य n. (fr. उपधर्म), false doctrine, heresy, BhP.
a: औपधर्म्यं — [उपधर्म-ष्यञ्] 1 A false doctrine, heresy. --2 Inferior virtue, or a degraded principle of virtue.

v: pu॰ upagatADenurasya tasyApatyam aR । suSrutokte DanvantariM prati praSnakArake fziBede । “kASIrAjaM divodAsaM DanvantarimOpaDenavavEtaraROraBrapuzkalAvatakaravIryyagopurarakzitasuSrutapraBftayaH UcuH । “OpaGenavamOramraM sOSrutaM pOzkalAvatam” suSru॰ ।
m: औपधेनव m. a descendant of Upadhenu, N. of a physician, Suśr.

v: na॰ upaDIyate ityupaDiH raTANgaM tataH svArTe QaYa । raTANge ।
m: औपधेय mfn. serving for the Upadhi (a particular part of the wheel of a carriage), Pāṇ. v, 1, 13
औपधेय n. the part of a wheel called Upadhi, Kāty. on ib.
a: औपधेय — a. (यी f.) [ उपधिठञ्] Serving for the part of the wheel of a carriage called उपधि, q. v. --यं The wheel of a carriage (रथांगं).

m: औपधिक mfn. (fr. उप-धि), deceitful, deceptive
औपधिक m. an impostor, cheat, Car.
an extortioner of money, Mn. ix, 258, (चोपधिका misprint for चौपधिका.)
a: औपधिक — a. (की f.) Deceitful, deceptive.

m: औपशाल mfn. (fr. शाला with उप), near the house or hall, Pat.
औपश See स्व्-औपश.
औपशद m. (fr. उप-शद), N. of an Ekāha, KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.; TāṇḍyaBr.
औपशमिक mfn. (fr. उप-शम), (with Jainas) resulting from the ceasing (of the effects of past actions), Sarvad.
औपशिवि m. a descendant of Upa-śiva, N. of a grammarian.

v: tri॰ upaSlezeRa nirvfttaH Wak । ekadeSena sambadDe ADAraBede “OpaSleziko vEzayiko'BivyApakaScetyADAra striDA” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: औपश्लेषिक mfn. (fr. उपश्लेष), connected by close contact, Siddh.
a: औपश्लेषिक — a. (की f.) [ उपश्लेषठक्] Relating to close or immediate contact.

v: puMstrI upavAhorapatyam bAhvA॰ iY । ucagata bAhorapatye ।
m: औपबाहवि m. a descendant of Upa-bāhu g. बाह्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 96.
औपबिन्दवि m. a descendant of Upa-bindu, ib.

v: pu॰ upacAra + svArTe--vinayAdi॰ Wak । upacAre upacAraSca lakzaRayA boDanam sevanaYca । upacAraH prayojanamasya WaY । upacArahetuke tri॰ । striyAM NIp । OpakAriko uktiH ।
m: औपचारिक mf(ई)n. (fr. उपचार), honorific, complimentary (as a name or title) Comm. on TāṇḍyaBr. xiv, 2, 6
not literal, figurative, metaphorical, Sarvad.
a: औपचारिक — a. (की f.) [ उपचारठक्] Metaphorical, figurative; secondary (opp. मुख्य). --कं Figurative application.

m: औपचायिक n. a kind of Śrāddha, L.

a: औपच्छंदसिकं — N. of a metre; see App.

v: tri॰ upacCandasA nirvfttaM bA॰ Wak । upacCandanena nirvftte । “AtanvAnaM murArikAntAsvOpacCasikaM hfdA vinodam” CandomaYja॰ । “gaqvizame'zwO same kalAstASca same syu rno nirantarAH । na samAtra parASritA kalA” iti vEtAlIyAdyalakzaRayukte “paryyante ryO taTEva SezamOpacCasikaM suDIBiH” vf॰ ra॰ ukte 2 mAtrAvftta Bede na॰ । “puzpitAgrABiDaM kecidOpacCasikaM viduH” ityukte 3 puzpitAgrAKyavarRRavfttaCandoBede ca ।
m: औपच्छन्दसिक mfn. (fr. उप-च्छन्दस्), conformable to the Veda, Vedic, VarBṛS.
औपच्छन्दसिक n. N. of a metre (consisting of four lines of alternately eleven and twelve syllabic instants See Gr. 969).

v: pu॰ upaca(ja)nDanasyApatyam iY । SuklayajabrAhmaRa vaMSIye fziBede । “Opaca(ja)nDanerOpaca(ja) nDaniH” Sata॰ 14, 5, 5, 21 । 14, 7, 3, 26, brAhmaRe ca ।
m: औपचन्धनि v.l. for औपजन्धनि, col. 2.

v: tri॰ upadeSena jIvati vetanA॰ Wak । upadeSopajIvini । upadeSena prAptaH bA॰ Wak । 2 upadeSena prApte ca
m: औपदेशिक mf(ई)n. living by teaching g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12 (not in Kāś.)
depending on or resulting from a special rule Comm. on KātyŚr. & ĀśvŚr.
(in Gr.) denoting or relating to an originally enunciated grammatical form (see उपदेश), Paribh. cxx, 2.
a: औपदेशिक — a. (की f.) [उपदेश ठक्] 1 Living by उपदेश or teaching. --2 Got by instruction (as wealth).

m: औपदेशिक—त्व n. the state of resulting from a special rule Comm. on KātyŚr. v, 11, 21.

v: tri॰ upadravamaDikftya kftogranTaH Wak । upadravADikAreRa suSrutAntargate granTaBede sa ca “aTAta OpradravikamaDyAyaM vyAKyAsyAmaH” ityupakramya uttaratantrArgataH suSrutakftaH ।
m: औपद्रविक mfn. (fr. उप-द्रव), relating to or treating of symptoms, Suśr.
a: औपद्रविक — a. (की f.) [ उपद्रवठक्] Relating to, or treating of, symptoms (of diseases).

v: pu॰ upadrazwf + svArTe zyaY । puruzameDIye devaBede । “viviktyE kzattAram, OpadrazwyAyAnukzattAram” yaju॰ 30, 93 । tatra taduddeSenAnukzattA dvArapAlasevakaH AlaByatvena vihitaH ।
m: औपद्रष्ट्र्य n. (fr. उपद्रष्टृ), the state of being an eye-witness, super-intendence, VS. xxx, 13.
a: औपद्रष्ट्र्यं — [उपद्रष्टृ-ष्यञ्] 1 Superintendence. --2 The state of being an eye-witness.

m: औपगात्र n. the state of an Upa-gātṛ q.v., ŚāṅkhBr.
औपगवीय m. a pupil of Aupagavi, Pat.

s: puM, upagorapatyam । iti BarataH ॥ upa samIpe gOryyasya iti upagurgopaH । lakzaRayA tatpurohite upaguSabdaH । yaTA hArItaH । “yaM varRaM yAjayed yastu sa tadvarRatvamApnuyAt sadyovarzeRa varzEScetvevamevAbravIdBfguH” ॥ * ॥ taTAca lakzaRayA brAhmaRa upagupadavAcyaH । tasyApatyaBOpagavaH । iti SrIBAgavatawIkAyAM svAmI । (upagoridamiti vyutpattyA upagusambanDini, triupagu + “tasyedam” । 4 । 3 । 120 । ityaR ॥)
v: puMstrI upagatogOrasya upagurgopaH tasyApatyam aR । 1 gopAlakaputre 2 tadyAjiputre ca lakzaRayA upaguSabdastaGAjivipro'pi upaguSabdenocyate “yaM varRRaM yAjavedyastu sa tadvarRRatvamApnuyAt । sadyovarzeRavarzEScetyevamevAbravIdBfguH” hArItokteH । tatsambanDini 3 lakzaRe 4 aNke 5 saMGe ca tasyApatye tu striyAM NIz । Opagavasyedam gotracaraRAt vuY” pA॰ vuY । Opagavaka OpagavasambanDini “tata Agata” ityaDikAre “gotrAdaNkavat” pA॰ vuY । Opagavaka tataAgate'rTe । tezAM samUhaH gotrokzozwretyAdinA vuY । Opagavaka tatsamUhe na॰ OpagavoBaktirasya “gotrakzatriyAKyeByo bahulam vuY” pA॰ । Opagavaka tadBaktiyukte tri
m: औपगव mf(ई)n. coming from or composed by Upagu
औपगव n. N. of two Sāmans, Lāṭy.
औपगव mf(ई). a descendant of Upagu, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 39.
औपगवक n. an assemblage of Aupagavas, ib.
औपगवक m. an admirer or worshipper of Upagu, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 99.

k.v: उदजस्तु पशुप्रेरणमकरणिरित्यादयः शापे। गोत्रान्तेभ्यस्तस्य वृन्दमित्यौपगवकादिकम्.।

v: puMstrI upagato gAM giraM patitvena upagavogIzpatistasyApatyam CAtro vA iY । 1 gIzpaterapatye 2 tacCAtre udDave pu॰ “kzaRamiva puline yamasvasustAM samuzita OpagavirniSAM tato'gAt” BAga॰ 3, 4, 28 “OpagavirudDavaH” SrIDaraH”
m: औपगवि m. a descendant of Aupagava, N. of Uddhava, BhP.
औपग्रहिक m. (fr. उपग्रह) id., W.

s: puM, (upagrastaM grAsakAlaM BUtaH । upagrasta + “tamaDIzwo Bfto BUto BAvI” । 5 । 1 । iti WaY .) rAhugrastaScandraH sUryyaSca । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: pu॰ upagrastaM grAsakAlaM BUtaH svasattayA vyAptaH “tamaDIScoBfto BUtoBAvo vA” pA॰ WaY । upagrAsakAlasya svasattayA vyApake 1 candre 2 sUryye ca Sabdara॰
m: औपग्रस्तिक m. (fr. उपग्रस्त), the sun or moon in eclipse, L.
a: औपग्रस्तिकः --ग्रहिकः — [उपग्रस्त-ग्रह ठञ्] 1 An eclipse. --2 The sun or moon in eclipse.

v: tri॰ upahArAya sADu Wak । upahArArTe dravye “paramAnnena yo dadyAt pitFRAmOpAhArikam” BA॰ anu॰ 6030 Slo॰ ।
m: औपहारिक mfn. (fr. उप-हार), fit for an offering
औपहारिक n. that which forms an oblation, an oblation, offering, MBh. xiii.
a: {{आपहारिक->औपहारिक||20170110||ह्त्त्प्स्:गित्हुब्.चोम्सन्स्क्रित्-लेऌइचोन्छौण्णैछ्थीऔङ्शिस्सुएस्332,|}} — a. (की f.) [ उपहारठक्] Serving as an oblation or offering. --कं An offering or oblation.

m: औपहस्तिक mfn. (fr. उप-हस्त, g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12[not in Kāś.]), living by presents (? प्रतिग्रहेण जीवति, T.)

v: tri॰ upajAnu jAnusamIpe prAyaBavaH Wak । jA nusamIpaparyyantavyApake “pARI yasyOpajAnukO” BawwiH ।
m: औपजानुक mfn. (fr. उप-जानु), being on or near the knees, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 40; Bhaṭṭ.
a: औपजानुक — a. (की f.) [ उपजानुठक्] Being near the knees.

m: औपजङ्घनि m. N. of a teacher (cf. ˚जन्धनि), Baudh.
औपजन्धनि m. a descendant of Upa-jandhani, N. of a teacher, ŚBr. xiv.
औपकारिक mfn. beneficial, useful, Daś.
औपकार्या f. = उप-कार्या, q.v., R.
औपकार्य n. a preparatory or secondary action, ĀpGṛ.
a: औपकार्यं, --र्या — [उपकार्य-अण्] A residence, a tent.

v: puMstrI upakasya gotrApatyaM naqA॰ Pak । upakasya gotrApatye । bahutve dvandve'dvandve ca vA Pako luk । upakA upakAyanAH । upakalAmakAH OpakAyanalAmavAyanAH ।
m: औपकायन m. a descendant of Upaka, N. of an author, Hcat.

v: tri॰ upakalApaM BavaH parimusvA॰ YA । kalApasamIpaBave ।
m: औपकलाप्य mfn. (fr. उपकलाप, g. परिमुखादि, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 58), being on or near the girdle (?).

v: tri॰ upakarRRaM prAyaBavaH Wak । karRRasamIpe prAyapraBave । “OpakarRRikalocanaH” । BawwiH ।

m: औपकर्णिक mfn. (fr. उपकर्ण), being on or near the ears, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 40.
a: औपकर्णिक — a. (की f.) [ उपकर्णठक्] Being near the ears.

m: औपकुर्वाणक = उपकुर्वाणक, q.v., BhP.
औपला f. N. of a Śakti, NṛsUp.
(v.l. ओमला.)

v: tni॰ upalAdAgataH SuRqikA॰ aR । 1 AyasTAna rUpopalAdAgate । upalasyedam aR । 2 prastarasambanDini “yaTA plavenOpalena nimajjatyudake taran” manuH ।
m: औपल mfn. (fr. उपल), made of stone, stony, Mn. iv, 194
raised from stones (as taxes) g. सुण्डिका, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 76
a: औपल — a. (ली f.) [उपल-अण्] 1 Stony, of stone. --2 Raised from stones (as a tax).

m: औपमानिक mfn. (fr. उपमान), derived by analogy Comm. on Nyāyad.

v: puMstrI upamanyorapatyaM vidA॰ aY । upamanyorapatye striyAM NIp । “prAcInaSAlaOpamanyavaH satyayajYaH pOluziH” । “Opamanyava! kiM tvamAtmAna mupAssva?” iti ca CA॰ u॰ ।
m: औपमन्यव m. a descendant of Upa-manyu, ŚBr.; ChUp.; Nir.
औपमन्यव (आस्), m. pl. N. of a school belonging to the Yajur-veda.

v: tri॰ upamayA nirddizwaH Wak । upamayAnirddizwe । “aBrAtfkAyA ityanivAhi OpamikaH” “maDu somami tyOpamikaM mAdyateH” “pIpilikAmaDyetyOpamikaM pIpilikA pelatergatakaH” iti ca niru॰ ।
m: औपमिक mfn. (fr. 3. उप-मा), serving for or forming a comparison, Nir.
a: औपमिक — a. (की f.) [उपमा-ठक्] 1 Serving for a simile or comparison. --2 Shown by a simile.

s: klI, (upamEva । caturvarRAditvAt svArTe zyaY .) sAdfSyam । tatparyyAyaH । anukAraH 2 anuMhAraH 3 । sAmyam 4 tulA 5 upamA 6 kakzaH 7 upamAnam 8 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, hitopadeSe 1 । 73 ॥ “prARA yaTAtmano'BIzwA BUtAnAmapi te taTA । AtmOpamyena BUtAnAM dayAM kurvvanti sADavaH” ॥ “OpamyaM nAma yadanyenAnyasya sAdfSyamaDikftya prakASanam । yaTA daRqena daRqakasya DanuzA DAnuzkasyezvAsenArogyadasyeti” । iti vimAnasTAne । 8 aDyAye ॥ carakeRoktam ॥)
v: na॰ upamA + cAtu svArTezyaY । 1 upamAyAm 2 sAdfSye “prARA yaTA no'BIzwA BUtAnAmapi te taTA । AtmOpamyena sarvatra yAM kurvanti sADavaH” hitopa॰ । “AtmOgamyena sarvvatraM gItA “sA pUrRA yadi sAmAnyaDarmma OpamyavAci ca” । “OpamyavAcino lopasamAse tadDite dviDA” iti ca sA॰ da॰ ।
m: औपम्य n. (ifc. f(आ). ) the state or condition of resemblance or equality, similitude, comparison, analogy, MBh.; BhP.; Bhag. &c. (cf. अनौप्˚, आत्मौप्˚, &c.)
a: औपम्यं — [उपमा-ष्यञ्] Comparison, resemblance, analogy; आत्मौपम्येन भूतेषु दयां कुर्वंति साधवः H. 1. 12; करका ˚रुभगः U. 3. 40 v. l.

v: tri॰ upanAsaM BavaH WaY striyAM NIp । nAsAsamIpaBave । “dvirdvAdaSa nAsAyAM tAsAmOpanAsikAScatasrastAH pariharet” suSrutaH ।
m: औपनासिक mfn. (fr. नासा with उप), being on or near the nose, Suśr.
a: औपनासिक — (की f.) [उपनास ठञ्] Being near the nose.

v: tri॰ upanayanaM prayojanamasya Wak anuSa॰ dvipadavfdDiH kullU॰ vastutaH upanAyanaSabdo'pi upanayanArTe prAguktaH tataH Wak ityeva nyAyyam । upanAyanaprayojanake viDAne “eza proktodvijAtInAmOpanAyaniko viDiH” manuH । upanAyanAya hitaH Wak । 2 upanayasADane ca । 2 brahmakzatraviSAM kAla OpanAyanikaH paraH” yAjYa॰ ।
m: औपनायनिक mfn. (fr. उप-नायन), relating to or fit for the ceremony called Upanayana q.v., Mn. ii, 68; Yājñ. i, 37.
a: औपनायनिक — a. (की f.) [ उपनयनठक्] Relating to or serving for उपनयन (the rite of investiture with the sacred thread); Ms. 2. 68; Y. 1. 37.

m: औपनायिक mfn. (fr. उप-नाय), belonging to or serving for an offering, Hariv.

v: tri॰ upanIvi nIvisamIpe prAyaBavaH Wak । nIvisamIpe prAyaBave “OpanIvikamarunDa kila strI vallaBasya karamAtmakarAByAm” mAGaH “badDodurbalarakzArTamasiryenOpanIvikaH” BawwiH ।
m: औपनीविक mfn. (fr. उप-नीवि), on or near the Nīvi (q.v.), Pāṇ. iv, 3, 40; Śiś. x, 60.
a: औपनीविक — a. (की f.) [ उपनीवि-ठक्] Being or placed near नीवि (the knot of the wearing garment) (of males or females), बद्धो दुर्बलरक्षार्थमसिर्येनौपनीविकः Bk. 4. 26; औपनीविकमरुंद्ध किल स्त्री (करं) Śi. 10. 60.

s: klI, (upaniDi + svArTa WaY .) upaniDiH । prItyA BogArTamaTitadravyam । iti smftiH ॥
v: na॰ upAnaDireva svArTe Wak । “vAsanasTamanAKyAya haste'nyasya yadarpyate । dravyaM tadOpaniDikaM pratideyaM taTEva tat” yAjYa॰ vivftirupaniDiSabde dfSyA ।
m: औपनिधिक mfn. (fr. उपनिधि), relating to or forming a deposit, Yājñ. ii, 65.
a: औपनिधिक — a. (की f.) [उपनिधि-ठक्] Forming, or relating to, a deposit. --कं A deposit or pledge; anything pledged or deposited; Y. 2. 65.

v: pu॰ upanizatsvevABivyajya te SEziko'R । upanizanmAtravedye 1 paramAtmani । “tantvOpanizadaM puruzaM pfcCAmi” vf॰ u॰ । upanizat brahmavidyA tasyA idam । 2 brahmapratipAdake vAkyAdO striyAM NIp । “viviDAScOpanizadIrAtmasaMsidDvaye SrutIH” manuH । upanizadi BavaH prakASyaH tasyAvyAKyAno granTovA fgayanA॰ aR । upanizatprakASye 3 brahmaRi tasyAvyAKyAne 4 granTe ca ।
m: औपनिषद mf(ई)n. contained or taught in an Upaniṣad, ŚBr. xiv; MuṇḍUp.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn. vi, 29, &c.
a follower of the Upaniṣads, a Vedāntin Comm. on Bādar. ii, 2, 10.
a: औपनिषद — a. (दी f.) [उपनिषद्-अण्] 1 Contained or taught in an Upaniṣad; scriptural, theological. --2 Based or founded on, derived from, the Upaniṣads; औपनिषदं दर्शनं (another name for Vedānta phil.) --दः 1 The supreme soul, Brahman. --2 A follower of the doctrines of the Upaniṣads.

m: औपनिषदिक mfn. Upaniṣad-like, Vātsy.

v: tri॰ upanizadA taduktopadeSena jIvati vetanA॰ Wak । upanizaduktopadeSenopajIvini ।
m: औपनिषत्क mfn. (fr. उपनिषद्, g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12), subsisting by teaching an Upaniṣad.
a: औपनिषत्क — a. (की f.) [ उपनिषदा जीवति ठक्] Living by (teaching) the Upaniṣads.

m: औपपादिक mfn. id., Car.
औपपादुक mfn. (fr. उप-पादुक), self-produced, Lalit.; Car.

v: tri॰ upapAtena upapAtakena gobaDAdinA saMsfzwaH Wak । upapAtakEH saMsfzwe “pitfdviw patitaH zaRqo yaSca syAdOpapAtikaH” nAra॰ “yaSca syAdupapAtakIti” prakASavfta pAWaH ।
m: औपपातिक mfn. (fr. उप-पातक irr.), one who has committed a secondary crime, Nār.
औपपातिक n. (fr. उप-पात) N. of the first Jaina Upāṅga.
a: औपपातिक — a. (की f.) [ उपपातठक्] One who has committed an Upapātaka, q. v.

v: tri॰ upapakzaM bAhumUlaM tasyedam zyaY । bAhumUlasambanDini । “tasmAdimAH prajA lomaSA jAyante yasmAdAsAM punariva SmaSrURyopapakzyARi durvIraRAni jAyante” Sata॰ brA॰ 11, 4, 1, 6 । “upapakzaM bAhumUlaM tatsambanDIni” BA॰ ।
m: औपपक्ष्य mfn. (fr. उप-पक्ष), being in the armpit (as hair), ŚBr. xi.
a: औपपक्ष्य — [उपपक्ष-ष्यञ्] Being in the arm pit.

v: tri॰ upapattyA kalpitam Wak । upapattyA 1 kalpite 2 yukte । “OpapattikamAhAraM prayacCasveti BArata!” BA॰ anu॰ 92 a॰ ।
m: औपपत्तिक mfn. (fr. उप-पत्ति), present, ready at hand, fit for the purpose, MBh.
a: औपपत्तिक — a. (की f.) [ उपपत्ति-ठक्] 1 Ready at hand, within reach. --2 Fit, proper. --3 Theoretical.

m: औपपत्य n. (fr. उप-पति), intercourse with a paramour, adultery, BhP. x, 29, 26.
औपराधय्य n. (fr. उपराधय, g. ब्राह्मणादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 124), the state of being serviceable or officious.
औपराजिक mf(ई and आ)n. (fr. उप-राज, g. काश्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 116), relating to a viceroy.
a: औपराजिक — a. [उपराज-ठक्] Belonging to a viceroy.
औपरैधिकः — A staff made of the wood of the Pīlu tree.

m: औपर अस्, m. a descendant of Upara, N. of Daṇḍa, TS.; MaitrS.
औपरव mfn. relating to the hole called Upa-rava, q.v. Comm. on KātyŚr. viii, 5, 7.

v: tri॰ uparizwAt BavaH aR । amehakvatasitreBya eva” vArtti॰ niyamAt na tyap wilopaH । uparizwAdBave ।
m: औपरिष्ट mfn. (fr. उपरिष्टात्, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 104), being above.
a: औपरिष्ट — a. (ष्टी f.) [उपरिष्ट-अण्] Bieng or produced above.

m: औपरिष्टक n. (scil. रत) a kind of coitus, Vātsy.

s: puM, (uparoDaH prayojanaBasya । uparoDa + Wak .) pIludaRqaH । tatparyyAyaH । pElavaH 2 । iti hemacandraH ॥ uparoDasambanDini tri ॥
v: tri॰ uparoDaH prayojanamasya Wak । 1 uparoDanimitte 2 pElave daRqe pu॰ hemaca॰ ।
m: औपरोधिक mfn. (fr. उप-रोध), relating to a check or hindrance, L.
a staff of the wood of the Pīlu tree, L.
a: औपरो(रौ)धिक — a. (की f.) [उपरोध-ठक्] 1 Proceeding from or relating to favour or kindness. --2 Opposing, impeding. --कः A staff of the wood of the Pīlu tree.

m: औपसीर्य mfn. (fr. उप-सीर, g. परिमुखादि, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 58), being on or near a plough.

v: tri॰ upasTAnaM SIlamasya CatrA॰ Ra । upasTAnaDIle upAsake ।
m: औपस्थान mf(ई)n. (fr. उपस्थान), one whose business is to serve or wait on or worship g. छत्त्रादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 62.
a: औपस्थान — (नी f.) [उपस्थान-ण] One whose business is to serve, wait on, or worship.

v: tri॰ upasTAnena sevanena jIvati vetanAM॰ Wak । sevanopajIvini ।
m: औपस्थानिक mf(ई)n. one who lives by waiting on or worshipping g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12.
a: औपस्थानिक — a. (की f.) [उपस्थान-ठक्] Living by waiting on or worshipping.

m: औपस्थूण्य mfn. (fr. उप-स्थूण, g. परिमुखादि, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 58), being near or on a post.
औपस्थिक mf(ई)n. (fr. उप-स्थ), living by the sexual organ (i.e. by fornication), ib.
a: औपस्थिक — a. [उपस्थ-ठक्] Living by fornication.

s: klI, (upasTAdBavam । upasTa + zyaY .) upasTendriyasuKam । iti SrIBAgavatam ॥ (yaTA, tatrEva 7 । 6 । 13 । “OpasTyajEhvyaM bahu manyamAnaH kaTaM virajyeta durantamohaH” ॥)
v: na॰ upasTasya BAvaH karmma vA zyaY । upasTavyApArasADye suKe । “OpasTyajEhmyakArpaRyAt” BAga॰ 7, 15, 16 “OpasTyajEhmyaM bahu manyamAnaH” BAga॰ 7, 6, 14 । OpasTyaMSESnyaM jEhyaYca suKam” SrIDaraH ।
m: औपस्थ्य n. cohabitation, sexual enjoyment, BhP.
a: औपस्थ्यं — [उपस्थ-ष्यञ्] Cohabitation, sexual intercourse.

m: औपसंध्य mfn. (fr. संध्या with उप), relating to dawn, Naiṣ.
औपसंख्यानिक mfn. (fr. उप-संख्यान), depending on the authority of any addition or supplement, mentioned or occurring in one
supplementary Comm. on Pāṇ.
a: औपसंख्यानिक — a. (की f.) [ उपसंख्यान-ठक्] 1 Mentioned in a supplementary addition. --2 Supplementary.

v: tri॰ upasaMkramaRe dIyate vyuzwA॰ aR । upasaMkramaRe deye striyAM NIp ।
m: औपसंक्रमण mf(ई)n. (fr. उप-संक्रमण), that which is given or proper to be done on the occasion of passing from one thing to another g. व्युष्टादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 97.
a: औपसंक्रमण — a. (णी f.) (Anything) proper to be done at the Upasaṃkramaṇa.

v: pu॰ upasacCabdo'sminnasti vimuktA॰ aR । upasacCabdayukte 1 svADAye 2 anuvAke ca । upasat samIpasTAnaM tadastyasya prajYA॰ aR । 3 dvandve “prajApatikAmasyOpasadaH” kAtyA॰ 22, 10, 13 । “OpasadodvandvaH” karkaH
m: औपसद mfn. occupied with or relating to the Upa-sad (q.v.) ceremony, ĀśvŚr.
(an Adhyāya or Anuvāka) in which the word उपसद् occurs g. विमुक्तादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 61
औपसद m. a particular Ekāha (incorrect v.l. for औपशद, p. 238, col. 3).
a: औपसदः — [उपसद्-अण्] 1 An अध्याय or अनुवाक containing the word उपसद्. --2 N. of a ceremony lasting for one day.

s: puM, (upasarga + Wak .) sannipAtarogaviSezaH । tasya lakzaRam । yaTA, -- “kaPo'nulomavAtena yadi pittAnugo Bavet । svedaSEtyAdiBirjuzwastadA Bavati mAnavaH ॥ pratilomaH punastena svAsTyamAyAti tatkzaRAt । Opasargika evAnyaH sannipAta udAhftaH” ॥ iti vEdyakam ॥ upasargasambanDini tri ॥ (“tatrOpasargiko yaH pUrvvotpannaMvyADiM jaGanyakAlajAto vyADirupasfjati sa tanmUlaevopadravasaMjYaH” । iti suSrute sUtrasTAne । 35 aDyAye ॥ “prasaNgAt gAtrasaMsparSAnniSvAsAt sahaBojanAt । sahaSayyAsanAccApi vastramAlyAnulepanAt ॥ kuzWaM jvaraSca SozaSca netrABizyanda eva ca । OpasargikarogASca saMkrAmanti narAnnaram” ॥ iti ca suSrute nidAnasTAne । 5 aDyAye ॥ mADavasaMgrahasya vyAKyAyAM kuzWADikAre yaTA । “OpasargikarogA iti OpasargikAH pAparogAdayo BUtopasargajAH saMkrAmanti AviSanti” ॥)
v: tri॰ upasargAya praBavati santApA॰ WaY । upasargasamarTe । sa ca suSrutoktaH rogaBadaH yaTA “vyADiviSezAstu prAgaBihitAH sarva evEte triviDAH sADyA yApyAH pratyAKyeyASca tatrEtAn BUyastriDA parIkzeta kimasAvOpasargikaH prAkkabalo'nyalakzaRa iti tatrOpasargiko yaH pUrvotpannaM vyADiM jaGanyakAlajAto vyADirupasfjati sa tanmUla evopadrava samBavaH” iti । vEdyakAntare tu “kaPo'nulomavAtena yadi pittAnugo Bavet । svedaSEtyAdiBirjuzwastadA Bavati mAnavaH । pratilomaH punastena svAsTyamAyAti tatkzaRAt । Opasargika evAnyaH sannipAta udAhftaH” ityukte 2 vAtAdisannipAte ca । 3 dEvArizwa sUcake grahadOsTyAdO । 4 upasargasambanDini tri॰ SabdakalpadrumaH । tanmUlaM mfgyam sambanDinyarTe Wako'smaraRAt kozAntarABAvAcca ।
m: औपसर्गिक mfn. (fr. उप-सर्ग), superior to adversity, able to cope with calamity g. संतापादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 101 superinduced, produced in addition to (or out of another disease), Suśr.
infectious (as a disease), Suśr. i, 271, 13
connected with a preposition, prepositive
portentous
relating to change &c., W.
औपसर्गिक m. irregular action of the humors of the body (producing cold sweat &c.), L.
a: औपसर्गिक — a. (की f.) [ उपसर्गठञ्] 1 Able to cope with adversity. --2 Portentous. --3 Relating to change &c. --4 Superinduced (as a disease). --5 Connected with a preposition. --कः Irregular action of the humours of the body, producing cold sweats &c. (वातादिसन्निपात).

m: औपस्वस्ती f. N. of a woman.
औपस्वस्ती—पुत्र m. N. of a teacher, BṛĀrUp.

v: pu॰ upataKinasyApatyam iY । upatastinasyApatye rAmanAmake fzO । “taduhovAca rAma OpatasviniH” Sata॰ brA॰ 4, 6, 1, 7 ।
m: औपतस्विनि m. a descendant of Upatasvina, N. of a Ṛṣi, ŚBr. iv.

v: pu॰ upavAhya eva svArTe'R । upavAhane raTAdO “OpabAhyaH kuverasya sArvaBOma ini SrutaH” rAmA॰ । sarvAsu BUmizu viditaH aR । sArvaBOma ityarTaH ।
m: औपवाह्य mfn. (fr. उप-वाह), designed for driving or riding (as a carriage or elephant &c.), R.
औपवाह्य m. a king's elephant, any royal vehicle.
a: औपवाह्य — a. [उपवाह्य स्वार्थे अण्] 1 Serving for riding on. --2 Drawn for pleasure (as a carriage). --ह्यः 1 A king's elephant. --2 Any royal vehicle.

v: tri॰ upavAse dIyate vyuzwA॰ aR । upavAsavrate dIyamAne dravye ।
m: औपवास mf(ई)n. (fr. उप-वास, g. व्युष्टादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 97), given during fasting, relating to fasting.
a: औपवास — a. (सी f.) [उपवास-अण्] Given during fasting (money); to be done during fast.

v: tri॰ upavAse sAGu guqA॰ WaY । 1 upavAse sADO । tasmE praBavati santApA॰ WaY । 2 upavAsasamarTe ca
m: औपवासिक mf(ई)n. fit or suitable for a fast g. गुडादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 103
able to fast g. संतापादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 101.
a: औपवासिक — a. (की f.) [उपवास-ठञ्] Fit for fasting; able to fast.

v: na॰ upavAsa + cAturva॰ svArTezyaY । upavAse “lakzmaRena yadAnItaM pItvA vAri samAhitaH । OpavAsyaM tadA'kArzIdrAGavaH saha sItayA” rAmA॰ ।
m: औपवास्य n. fasting, R.
a: औपवास्यं — Fasting.

m: औपवीली f. v.l. for ओविली, q.v.
औपवीतिक n. (fr. उप-वीत), investiture with the sacred thread, VāmP.
औपवस्थ n. = औपवस्त above.

v: tri॰ upavasaTe BavaH WaY । upavasaTakarttavye karmmAdO । upavasaTaSca grAmaH yAgapUrvadivasaSca upavasaTaSabde uktaH । zyaY OpavasaTya tatrArTe । “agnipraRayanIyA OpavasaTye'niyamaH” ASva॰ SrO॰ 4, 1, 26 । svArTe zyaY । “yAgapUrvvadine ca । “OpavasaTye'hni” SrutiH ।
m: औपवसथिक mfn. designed for or belonging to the Upa-vasatha (q.v.) ceremony, ĀśvŚr.; Gobh. &c.
औपवसथिक n. N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda.
औपवसथ्य mfn. = औपवसथिक above, AitBr.; ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.
औपवस्त n. (fr. उप-वस्त), fasting, a fast, Āp. ii, 1, 5.
a: औपवस्तं — Fasting, a fast.

k.v: औपवस्तं तूपवासो विवेकः पृथगात्मता। स्याद्ब्रह्मवर्चसं वृत्ताध्ययनर्द्धिरथाञ्जलिः॥

v: na॰ upavastrameva prajYA॰ aR । 1 upavastre upavastuH karma aR । 2 upavAse । upavastA prApto'syeti vigfhya “ftoraR” pA॰ sUtrapradarSanaM prAmAdikameva । tatra ftuSabdasyEva grahaRaM na tu fdantasya taTAtve fto'R ityeva syAt ArttavamityudAharaRaM cAsaNgatam iti boDyam “mAzAn maDumasUrAMSca varjjavedOpavastrakft” smftiH
m: औपवस्त्र n. fasting, L.
a: औपवस्त्रं — [उपवस्त्र-अण्] 1 Food suitable for a fast. --2 Fasting.

m: औपवस्त्रक n. food suitable for a fast, L.
औपवेशि इस्, m. a descendant of Upa-veśá, N. of Aruṇa, TS.; ŚBr.

v: tri॰ upaveSena jIvati vetanA॰ WaY । upaveSenopajIvini ।
a: औपवेशिक — a. (की f.) [ उपवेशठञ्] Getting livelihood by entire devotion to any employment.

m: औपवेषिक mfn. (fr. उप-वेष, g. वेतनादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 12), living by entertainment (?).

v: puMstrI । upavindorapatyam bAhvA॰ iY । upavindorapatye striyAM NIp ।
tri॰ upayogaH prayIjanamasya WaY । upayoganimitte “aTAtaH snehOpayOgikaM cikitsitaM vyAKyAsyAmaH” suSru॰ striyAM NIz ।
m: औपयौगिक mfn. (ifc.) relating to the application of (a remedy &c.), Suśr.
a: औपयौगिक — a. (की f.) [ उपयोगठञ्] Relating to the employment or application (of anything).

v: tri॰ upayajEdam aR । upayajaH sambanDini upa yaw ca tacCabde darSitaH । “mArjite prezyatyagnIdOpayajAnaNgArAnAharati” kAtyA॰ 6, 9, 7
m: औपयज mfn. belonging to the verses called Upayaj, q.v., KātyŚr.; ĀśvŚr.
a: औपयज — a. (जी f.) [ उपयज्-अण्] Belonging to the sentences called उपयज्, q. v.

s: tri, (upAyena saYjAtaH । upAya + Wak + hrasvaSca .) nyAyyaH । upayuktaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate vidurAgamanaparbbaRi 1 । 205 । 12 । “etattava mahArAja tezu puttrezu cEva ha । vfttamOpayikaM manye BIzmeRa saha mArata” ! ॥ taTA rAmAyaRe 2 । 54 । 39 । “vAsamOpayikaM manye tava rAma mahAbala” । striyAM tu NIp । yaTA mahABArate vEvAhikaparbbaRi 1 । 194 । 11 । “na vESyaSUdrOpayikIH kaTAstA na ca dvijAnAM kaTayanti vIrAH” ॥ svArTe vinayAdiByazWakpratyaye kfte upAyaeva OpayiMkam । yaTA BAraviH, 35 । “SivamOpayikaM garIyasIm” iti ॥
v: tri॰ upa + aya--GaY upAyastena labDaH Wak hrasvaSca । 1 upAyalabDe, 2 yukte nyAyAgatabastuni ca । “etattava mahArAja! putrezu tezu cEva hi । vfttamOpayikaM manye BIzmeRa saha BArata!” BA॰ A॰ 204 a॰ । striyAM NIpra । “nacEvOpayikI BAryyA mAnuzI kfpaRA tava” BA॰ va॰ 280 a॰ “yadatrOpayikaM kAryyaM taccintayitumarhasi” BA॰ u॰ 177 a॰ । upAyaeva vinayA॰ svArTe Wak hrasvaSca । 3 upAye pu॰ । “SivamOpayikaM garIyasIm” kirA॰ । “Opayikam upAyam” malli॰ ।
m: औपयिक mf(ई)n. (fr. उपाय, g. विनयादि, Pāṇ. v, 4, 34; with shortening of the आ, Kāś. on ib.), answering a purpose, leading to an object, fit, proper, right, MBh.; BhP. &c.
belonging to, VarBṛS.
obtained through a means or expedient, L.
औपयिक n. a means, expedient, Kir. ii, 35.
a: औपयिक — a. (की f.) [उपाय-ठक्] 1 Proper, fit, right. --2 Obtained by efforts. --कः --कं A means, an expedient, remedy; शिवमौपयिकं गरीयसीं Ki. 2. 35.

k.v: अभ्रेषन्यायकल्पास्तु देशरूपं समञ्जसम्. युक्तमौपयिकं लभ्यं भजमानाभिनीतवत्.।

m: औपयिक—ता f.
औपयिक—त्व n. fitness, properness, Sarvad. Comm. on KātyŚr. &c.

a: औपेंद्र — a. Belonging to Upendra; Śi. 20. 79.

m: औपेन्द्र mfn. relating to Viṣṇu, Śiś.
औपोद्घातिक mfn. (fr. उपोद्घात), occasioned, occasional Comm. on ṢaḍvBr.
औपोदितेय m. a descendant of Aupoditī, ŚBr. i.

औडायन m. a descendant of Uḍa (?) or of Auḍa [T. ?], g. ऐषुकार्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 54.
औडायन—भक्त mfn. inhabited by Auḍāyanas (as a country), ib.

v: pu॰ oqava + svArTe'R । “OqavaH paYcaBiH proktaH svarEH zaqqistu zAqavaH । sampUrRRA saptaBiH proktA rAga jAtistiDA matA” saNgItaratnA॰ ukte rAgaBede । sa ca BallArAdiH iti saMgItadAmodaraH ।
m: 1. औडव mf(ई)n. (fr. उडु), relating to a constellation, Kād.
2. औडव m. (in mus.) a mode which consists of five notes only
a: औडव — a. (वी f.) [उडु-अण्] Belonging to stars; K. 178. --वः A kind of Rāga (in Music).

m: औडवि m. pl. N. of a warrior tribe g. दामन्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 3, 116 (not in Kāś.)

m: औड्र v.l. for ओड्र, q.v.
a: औड्रः — [ओड्र-अण्] An inhabitant, or the king, of the Odra country, q. v.
औडुंबर — = औदुंबर q. v.

m: औडुलोमि m. a descendant of Uḍu-loman, N. of a philosopher, Bādar.

puM, caturddaSayamAntargatayamaviSezaH । iti medinI ॥ muniviSezaH । yaTA, -- “vEKAnasA bAliKilyOqumbarAH PenapA vane । nyAse kuwIcakaH pUrvvaM bahvodo haMsanizkriyO” ॥ iti SrIBAgavate 3 । 12 । 43 । “OqumbarAH prAtarutTAya yAM diSaM praTamaM paSyanti tata AhftEH PalAdiBirjIvantaH” । iti tawwIkAyAM svAmI ॥
v: tri॰ uqu(du)mbarasya vikAraH rajatAdi॰ aY । 1 tAmravikAre pAtrAdO । “gfhItvOqu(du)mbaraM pAtram smftiH “sOvarRRarAjatOqumbaraKAqgamaRimayAnAM pAtrARAm” goBi॰ । 2 yajYANgavfkzavikAre ca । “paScAtpatiravasTAya yugamantamOqu(du)mbaraM SalAwugraTna mA baDnAti” goBi॰ । striyAM NIp । Oqu(du)mbarIM spfzwvA gAyeta” SrutiH । “Oqu(du)mbarIM SAKAmupagUhati” Sata॰ brA॰ 5, 4, 3, 25, 3 tapasviviSeze pu॰ । “vEKAnasA bAliKilyOqumbarAH PenapAvane । nyAse kuwIcaraH pUrvvam bahvodo haMsanizkriyO” BAga॰ 3, 12, 27 । “Oqu(du)mbarAH prAtarutTAya yAM diSaM praTamaM paSyanti tata AhfnaPalAdiBiH jIvantaH” SrIDaraH । OqumbaraM tatPalaM tasyevAkAro'styasya arSa॰ ac । 4 mahAkuzWaBede । “tatra mahAkuzWAnyaruROqumbararzya jihvakapAlakAkaRapuRqarIkadadrukuzWAnIti” viBajya “pittena pakvOqumbaraPalAkftivarRAnyOqumbarARIti” tallakzma suSrute uktam । sa ca rogaH tAmrasteyakarmavipAkaH yaTAha SAtA॰ “Oqu(du)mbarI tAmracOro narakAnte prajAyate” । 5 yamaBede ca “OqumbarAya daDnAya” yamatarpaRamantraH ।
m: औडुम्बर See औदुम्बर.

m: औडुप mfn. (fr. उडुप), relating to a raft or float, g. संकलादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 75.
a: औडुप — a. [उडुप-अण्] Performed by means of the moon or raft.

m: औडुपिक mfn. carrying over in a boat g. उत्सङ्गादि, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 15.
a: औडुपिक — a. (की f.) [उडुपेन तरति ठक्] Crossing in a boat. --कः A passenger in a boat or raft.

m: औरा f. N. of a woman.
और्ध्व (fr. ऊर्ध्व, q.v.), in the following compounds:
और्ध्वभक्तिक mfn. (fr. ऊर्ध्व-भक्त), used or applied after a meal, Car.
और्ध्वंदमिक mfn. (fr. ऊर्ध्वं-दम), belonging to an elevated or upright person or thing, Pat. on Pāṇ. iv, 3, 60.
और्ध्वदैहिक mfn. = और्ध्वदेहिक, L.
और्ध्वदेह mfn. (fr. ऊर्ध्व-देह), relating or referring to the state after death, relating to future life, R. ii, 83, 24.
a: और्ध्वदेहं — [उर्ध्वदेह-अण्] A funeral ceremony.

m: और्ध्वदेहिक mfn. id.
relating to a deceased person, performed in honour of the dead, funereal, funeral
और्ध्वदेहिक n. the obsequies of a deceased person, any funeral ceremony
whatever is offered or performed on a person's decease (as burning of the body, offering cakes, distributing alms &c.), Mn. xi, 10; MBh.; R.; Ragh. &c.
a: और्ध्वदे(दै)हिक — a. (की f.) [ ऊर्ध्वदेहाय साधु ठञ्] Relating to a deceased person, funeral, performed in honour of the dead (as a rite); ˚क्रिया obsequies, funeral rites; Pt. 1. --कं Funeral rites, obsequies.

a: और्ध्वकालिक — a. (की f.) [ ऊर्ध्वकाल-ष्ठञ्] Relating to subsequent or later time.

m: और्ध्वसद्मन n. (fr. ऊर्ध्व-सद्मन्), N. of a Sāman, TāṇḍyaBr.; Lāṭy.
और्ध्वस्रोतसिक m. (fr. ऊर्ध्व-स्रोतस्), a Śaiva (q.v.), L.
a: और्ध्वस्रो(श्रो)तसिकः — = शैवः, a Śaiva or an adherent of the sect.

m: और्णावत्य m. (nom. pl. ˚वतास्), a descendant of Ūrṇāvat, Pāṇ. v, 3, 118.
और्णायव n. (fr. ऊर्णायु), N. of a Sāman, TāṇḍyaBr. &c.

a: और्ण, और्णक, और्णिक — a. (र्णी, --की f.) [ऊर्णा-अञ्, वुञ् वा] Woollen.

of several other men, ŚBr. &c.
और्णिक mf(ई)n. woollen g. अश्वादि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 39.

औरभ्र n. mutton, the flesh of sheep
woollen cloth, W.

a: औरभ्रकं — [उरभ्राणां समूहः वुञ्] A flock of sheep.

(also) a sheep butcher, L. i.
a: औरभ्रिक — a. [उरभ्र-ठञ्] (की f.) Belonging to sheep. --कः A shepherd.

m: औरग mfn. (fr. उर-ग), relating or belonging to a snake, serpentine, MBh.; Naiṣ.
औरग n. N. of the constellation Āśleṣā, L.
a: औरग — a. (गी f.) [उरग-अण्] Serpentine, relating to a serpent. --गं The constellation आश्लेषा.

m: औरसायनि m. a descendant of Uras g. तिकादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 154
a descendant of Aurasa, ib.
औरसी f. a legitimate daughter, Dāy.; Naiṣ.

v: pu॰ urasA nirmmitaH yadaBAve aR । “savarRRAyAM saMskftAyAM svayamutpAdayettu yam । OrasaM taM vijAnIyAt putraM praTamakalpitam” manUkte putraBede “OrasaH kzetrajaScEva dattaH kftrima eva ca” manunA dvAdaSaviDaputramaDye tasya prATamyokteH “aNgAdaNgAt samBavati” AtmA vE jAyate putra” SruteSca svadehajAtatvenAsya taTAtvam । 1 urasAnirmmitamAtratvena asavarRRAgutre parapUrvvAputre'pi OrasaSabdasya vfttiH ataeva “arjunasya parapUrvvAyAM nAgakanyAyAmutpannamErAvatamaBipretya” BA॰ BI॰ 91 a॰ “ajAnan arjunaScApi nihataM putramOrasam” ErAvatasya OrasatvaviSezaRam । “ekaevOrasa putraH sarvvasya vasunaH praBuH” manuH “OrasaH kzetrajaH putrO pitfrikTasya BAginO” smftiH Orase punarutpanne tftIyAMSaharAH sutAH” manuH urasa idamaR । 2 hfdayaBave tri॰ urasA nAma puroBedaH tatra BavaH sinDvA॰ aR । 3 Orasa urasApuroBave tri॰ ।
m: 1. औरस mf(ई)n. (fr. उरस्), belonging to or being in the breast, produced from the breast, MBh.
innate, own, produced by one's self, Suśr.

an own son, legitimate son (one by a wife of the same caste married according to the prescribed rules), Mn. ix, 166, &c.; Yājñ. ii, 128, &c.; Hit.; R. &c.
2. औरस mfn. coming from or belonging to Uraśā g. सिन्ध्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 93.
a: औरस — a. (सी f.) [उरसा निमिंतः अण्] Produced from the breast, born of oneself, legitimate; Ś. 7; V. 5; R. 16. 88. --सः, --सी A legitimate son or daughter; Y. 2. 128.

k.v: आहुर्दुहितरं सर्वेऽपत्यं तोकं तयोः समे। स्वजाते त्वौरसोरस्यौ तातस्तु जनकः पिता॥

m: औरसि m. a descendant of Uras (?).

m: 1. और्व m. a descendant of Ūrva, N. of a Ṛṣi, RV. viii, 102, 4; TS. vii; AitBr.; MBh. &c.

(in later mythology he is called Aurva Bhārgava as son of Cyavana and grandson of Bhṛgu; he is the subject of a legend told in MBh. i, 6802; there it is said that the sons of Kṛtavīrya, wishing to destroy the descendants of Bhṛgu in order to recover the wealth left them by their father, slew even the children in the womb; one of the women of the family of Bhṛgu, in order to preserve her embryo, secreted it in her thigh [ऊरु], whence the child at its birth was named Aurva; on beholding whom, the sons of Kṛtavīrya were struck with blindness, and from whose wrath proceeded a flame that threatened to destroy the world, had not Aurva at the persuasion of the Bhārgavas cast it into the ocean, where it remained concealed, and having the face of a horse; Aurva was afterwards preceptor to Sagara and gave him the Āgneyāstram, with which he conquered the barbarians who invaded his possessions; cf. वडवा-मुख, वडवाग्नि)
N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha, Hariv.

a: और्व — a. (र्वी f.) [ऊरु-अण्] 1 Relating to Aurva. --2 Produced from the thigh. --3 Relating to the earth. --र्वः 1 N. of a celebrated Ṛṣi. [He was a descendant of Bhṛgu, (the son of Cyavana by his wife Āruṣī, and grandson of Bhṛgu). The Mahābhārata relates that the sons of Kārtavīrya, with the desire of destroying the descendants of Bhṛgu, killed even the children in the womb. One of the women of the family in order to preserve her embryo secreted it in her thigh (ūru), whence the child at its birth was called Aurva. Beholding him the sons of Kārtavīrya were struck with blindness, and his wrath gave rise to a flame which threatened to consume the whole world, had he not, at the desire of his Pitṛs, the Bhārgavas, cast it into the ocean, where it remained concealed with the face of a horse; cf. Vaḍavāgni. Aurva was afterwards preceptor to king Sagara of Ayodhyā]. --2 Submarine fire; त्वयि ज्वलत्यौर्व इवांबुराशौ Ś. 3. 3; so ˚अनलः. --र्वं Fossil salt.
